releases.artist: Harlem Underground Band / Mighty Tom Cats
releases.title: Smokin' Cheeba-Cheeba / Dance Girl
releases.label: Paul Winley Records
releases.details: Originally issued on Paul Winley Records in 1973, “Smokin' Cheeba-Cheeba”—with Ann Winley on vocals—became a cornerstone of the 1980s UK Rare Groove scene, earning cult-classic status among collectors and DJs alike. On the flip, “Dance Girl”—also released under the Rimshots name—serves up one of the era’s most revered up-tempo breaks. Its unmistakable groove has been sampled by The Roots, Large Professor, and many others, cementing its place in hip-hop production history. The creative nucleus behind both The Mighty Tom Cats and The Rimshots would later evolve into the legendary Fatback Band, adding another layer of pedigree to this essential pairing. With original copies fetching high prices on Discogs, this special-edition orange vinyl Dinked 7-inch, housed in a branded Paul Winley Records sleeve for Record Store Day, offers a rare chance to own two deep-cut funk/soul essentials on one collectible release.

releases.title: Bicycles & Tricycles

The album features Orb long-term collaborators Thomas Fehlmann, Simon Phillips, John Roome and The KLF’s Jimmy Cauty.

This special ltd edition is pressed on red & black smoke double vinyl, housed in a widespine, spot glossed sleeve with printed inners. This re-press also Includes an extra track ‘Now Here’ originally only available on the Japanese release of the album.

releases.title: Read & Burn 03 + -
releases.label: pinkflag
releases.details: Released at the end of the initial period of Wire’s 3rd act – after Send and before the band’s post-Bruce Gilbert re-invention – Read & Burn 03 never quite got the attention it deserved. However the opening track 23 Years Too Late, with its tour narrative text and motorik rhythm stands as one of the band’s finest achievements of any era in the view of both core fans & the band (a rare point of agreement!). The original EP, 3rd in the Read & Burn series and the one not compiled on to the Send album, was the last non-historic release by the original Wire line up of Colin Newman, Graham Lewis, Bruce Gilbert & Robert Grey and has never been properly released on vinyl. The 2026 version brings the original 4 tracks and adds 3 more. While some of the tracks originated as part of the 2001-2002 sessions that gave forth Send, others have a more storied history. 23 Years Too Late actually started life as a highly transformed cover of the 70’s Wire single Dot Dash – performed under the name Dip Flash as part of Iain Sinclair's London Orbital, a night at the Barbican London on 25th October 2002, celebrating London’s M25 motorway (AKA The Orbital). The never previously released piece in its original form is included as an additional track. Meanwhile Desert Diving actually started life as a version of the Chairs Missing track Heartbeat as performed live at the Garage, London during Wire’s series of concerts there in May 2000. The original version of Our Time and an alternate mix of Desert Diving are the other additional tracks. The CD & digital versions will add the 3:17 edit of 23 Years Too Late which will also serve as the lead track for promo purposes.

releases.title: As Time Explodes
releases.label: Reprise / Warner Records
releases.details:
Shortly after the release of Neil Young & the Chrome Hearts' album Talkin To The Trees in June 2025, the band embarked on a 31-date tour of Europe and North America. This live album includes selections from several shows. The 13-track album includes songs that span Young’s entire career; including “Ohio” and “After The Gold Rush” from 1970 to “Silver Eagle” from the 2025 album, Talkin To The Trees. Also in the set list are Young classics such as “Harvest Moon”, “Like A Hurricane”, “Cortez The Killer”, and “Vampire Blues”. Making this album extra-special is the new song “Big Crime”, plus songs that have rarely been featured on recent Neil Young live albums, including “Long Walk Home”, “Daddy Went Walking”, “Be The Rain”, and “Name of Love”The European dates included performances at the legendary Glastonbury Festival, London’s Hyde Park and the Montreux Jazz Festival in Switzerland.

Neil Young & the Chrome Hearts are:

Neil Young (guitar, pump organ, piano and vocals)
Spooner Oldham (organ and piano)
Micah Nelson (guitar, Stringman and vocals)
Corey McCormick (bass and vocals)
Anthony LoGerfo (drums and vocals)

The 13-track album includes songs that span Young’s entire career.
The record is produced by Lou Adler with the Volume Dealers - Neil Young and Niko Bolas, and associate producer Anthony LoGerfo.

releases.title: Passing Stranger
releases.label: Shedio Records
releases.details:
Groundbreaking debut album Passing Stranger launched Scott Matthews' career when it was released in 2006 to widespread critical acclaim, leading to an Ivor Novello for "Best Song Musically and Lyrically" for the single 'Elusive'. Comparisons were made to Jeff Buckley and Nick Drake, alongside fellow Wolves supporter Robert Plant, with whom Matthews' has since collaborated and toured. Both Zane Lowe and Jo Whiley picked ‘Elusive' as their Single of the Week. The album drew in a host of A-list fans including Dave Grohl, Damon Albarn and Guy Pearce, who went on to star in the stunning Damien Hyde-directed video for 'Wait In The Car' from Matthews' most recent album Restless Lullabies.

With noted hints of Neil Finn, Thom Yorke & Jeff Buckley, the album was described as a "gem of an album" by the BBC on release, and features the track 'Elusive', which won the the 2007 Ivor Novello Award for "Best Song Musically and Lyrically”.

Considered by many to be one of his finest sessions as a bandleader, the album features a stripped-back and direct performance of rhythm and melody. This album was recorded right after Muhammad's work on Pharoah Sanders's Journey to the One, and the two musicians would later reunite for several more releases on the Theresa label. The album's last reissue was a limited UK-only LP run in 2020.

releases.title: Bobby Digital Presents: The Juice Crew
releases.label: 36 Chambers / DNA / Hitmaker
releases.details:
Limited Edition, Audiophile-Grade, Collector's Quality LP Vinyl Set Manufactured using Buyer-Sourced Neotech 100% Virgin Vinyl for reduced degradation, extending lifetime playback quality. The Manufacturing-Exclusive Technology employed in mastering this pressing uses predictive analysis to identify and correct groove deformation. The resulting pressings are unrivaled in replicating the intended audio equalization of the original studio performance, enhancing layered sonic nuances often not detected in traditional mastering 

colllectors quality LP, packaged in a 1 of 1 album cover variant

A historic bridge between two eras of hip-hop mastery.

Bobby Digital Presents: The Juice Crew is a once-in-a-generation collaboration that unites two of hip-hop’s most influential forces: RZA—visionary architect of the Wu-Tang Clan—and the legendary Juice Crew, whose pioneering MCs laid the foundation for lyricism, storytelling, and New York rap culture. Curated and produced under RZA’s Bobby Digital persona, this project reimagines the golden-era ethos through a futuristic Shaolin lens, creating a timeless cross-chamber experience.

The album is both homage and evolution. RZA pulls from decades of sonic experimentation—Shaolin drums, cinematic textures, digital grit, and soulful samples—while the Juice Crew delivers commanding performances that remind the world why their legacy remains unshakable. Each track builds its own universe: sharp lyricism, master craftsmanship, and generational excellence woven into a cohesive body of work.

This project is more than a collaboration—it’s a cultural moment. It marks the first time the worlds of the Abbott and the Juice Crew converge on record, forming a bridge between iconic rap lineages that shaped the artform. The result is bold, vibrant, and deeply rooted in hip-hop heritage, yet engineered for a new era of listeners.

Bobby Digital Presents: The Juice Crew stands as testament to the enduring power of lyricism, innovation, and artistic unity—an album that celebrates history while pushing the sound of hip-hop forward.

Now, the fan-favourite track finally gets its moment, arriving exclusively for Record Store Day on baby blue 7” vinyl with a disco ball etching on Side B.

releases.title: The Great Western Road Trip: A Live Album
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details:
On March 30th we gave the first performance of The Great Western Road Trip at Edinburgh’s Usher Hall.

As if opening night anxiety was not enough, we were also playing nine new songs for the very first time with the added fear factor of a request by BBC Scotland to record the concert. Somehow all of these factors combined to focus us into playing, what we now realise, was one of our best performances there or anywhere for some time.

There was one unknown factor. That night was to be the last time we would play in Scotland with our friend and brother James Miller Prime. So, this is a very special recording of six close friends and musicians making music, unaware they were on their last ever run of shows together. We hope the excitement we felt at creating the show comes over and you enjoy this unique recording of very special Edinburgh night.

Dedicated to James Miller Prime
(3 November 1960 – 19 June 2025)

Includes 25 career spanning greatest hits and nine tracks from 2025's Top 3 album The Great Western Road.

releases.title: Normal Isn't Live
releases.label: BMG

Fronted by Maynard James Keenan, the uncompromising rock collective delivers raw, immersive, and electric performances from start to finish. Each track unfolds with a newfound immediacy, as the band transforms the venue into a hypnotic soundscape of pulsing rhythms and surreal storytelling. Featuring a live rendition of the standout single “Self Evident,” this recording captures Puscifer at their most dynamic — a rare, visceral experience shared between artist and audience in the closest of quarters.

releases.title: Live at the Jazz Showcase
releases.label: Resonance Records
releases.details: JOE HENDERSON — Consonance: Live at the Jazz Showcase is the first ever release of saxophone titan Joe Henderson and his quartet featuring pianist Joanne Brackeen, bassist Steve Rodby and drummer Danny Spencer captured live at Joe Segal's Jazz Showcase in Chicago, IL in February of 1978. The limited-edition 180-gram 3-LP (and 2-CD) set was mastered from the original tapes by George Klabin and John Koenig, with lacquers cut by Matthew Lutthans at The Mastering Lab in Salina, KS, and pressed at Quebec's boutique audiophile pressing plant Le Vinylist. This is part of Resonance's debut launch of releases from Joe Segal's Jazz Showcase archives, marking the beginning of what will hopefully be a long line of incredible releases from the club's archives. The deluxe package includes newly curated liner notes by co-producer John Koenig, plus interviews with Joanne Brackeen, Steve Rodby, Danny Spencer, Joe Segal's son Wayne Segal and more

releases.title: Live at Revolution Hall
releases.label: 4AD
releases.details: 3LP - In early 2025, Big Thief songwriter Adrianne Lenker shared a 120-minute, 43-track intimate live album entitled Live at Revolution Hall, an immersive sonic documentary compiled across three days of performances. Now, the album is being pressed to Standard Black Vinyl for the very first time, exclusive to Record Store Day 2026. Amid collaged soundbites of enthused applause and audience chatter, producer Andrew Sarlo takes listeners stage-side, where Lenker and her band (including Josefin Runsteen and Nick Hakim) embark on a setlist of deep-cuts, fan favorites (such as “not a lot, just forever” and “anything”), and unreleased gems (including “oldest” and “happiness”), delivered via twinkling keys, chill-inducing cello passages, and Lenker’s emotionally stirring vocal delivery. Says Lenker of the release, “Here is a little lighting in a jar, a capture of the spirit of all shows I’ve ever played and ever will play. The music is alive, and the magic of recording is letting us get close to that spark at anytime, anywhere, and if we want to - over and over again”.Trackliisting: A1 hello, i love you & blue lightning, A2 - door & how are you? -, A3 little things, A4 happiness, A5 cut my hair, A6 time escaping & wild whistling, B1 cattails & soundcheck, B2 ruined (check), B3 - nick & josefin -, B4 symbol, B5 real house, B6 indiana & sneezing, B7- now westlin winds -, C1 i do love you, C2 - brief message for adrianne -, C3 heavy focus, C4 vampire empire, C5 - lady midnight, I’ll tape you back together -, C6 born for loving you, C7 i will always love you, C8 - noah -, C9 spud infinity, D1 - oso -, D2 promise is a pendulum, D3 - backwards intermission -, D4 evol (kcehc), D5 fangs, D6 oldest, D7 sadness as a gift, E1 - drawing a star -, E2 orange, E3 two reverse, E4 free treasure & fire trucks, E5 ripples & happy birthday alice, E6 fool, E7 not a lot, just forever, E8 - naljf & crowd-, F1 no limit, F2 donut seam, F3 zombie girl, F4 - happy birthday everyone -, F5 anything, F6 wake me up to drive (outside)

releases.title: Good Morning It's Now Tomorrow (5th Anniversary Collector's Edition)
releases.label: Nettwerk
releases.details:
To celebrate the 5th anniversary of Good Morning It’s Now Tomorrow, British-Canadian singer-songwriter Matt Maltese presents this special 2LP collector’s edition, uniting his acclaimed third studio album with the madhouse and Quiet Recordings EPs — the latter appearing on vinyl for the first time, exclusively for Record Store Day.

Pressed on ultra clear vinyl and housed in a deluxe gatefold sleeve, this edition showcases the songwriting prowess that has made Maltese one of the UK’s most distinctive voices. From the lush pop melancholy of Good Morning It’s Now Tomorrow to the intimate reimaginings of Quiet Recordings, the depth and range of Maltese’s artistry are apparent throughout.

releases.title: Happiness in Liquid Form EP
releases.label: Chess Club
releases.details:
At only 23 years old and with half a billion streams, 5 EPs and 2 full length albums, headline tours across UK, Europe, Asia, Australia & USA, and collaborations with Nile Rodgers and Todd Rundgren under his belt, Alfie Templeman continues to go from strength to strength. 

This year marks the 5 year anniversary of his career-changing EP 'Happiness in Liquid Form' and to celebrate Alfie & Chess Club Records are excited to announce a vinyl reissue of this seminal EP - pressed exclusively for Record Store Day 2026.  

With the original 10” vinyl pressed in small quantity and sold out on pre-order, this 12” reissue comes in the form of a picture disc vinyl featuring the original EP on Side A, containing 2 of his most beloved fan favourites 'Things I Thought Were Mine' & 'Happiness in Liquid Form', as well as his collaboration with label mates Coach Party, 'My Best Friend'.  

Side B boasts 2 never-before-heard tracks from the Happiness in Liquid Form era, 'Only One' and 'Endlessly', both produced by The Vaccines founding member & drummer Pete Robertson whose production credits include Beabadoobee, Hinds, Jane's Addiction, Keo. Side B also features live & acoustic versions of breakout single 'Happiness in Liquid Form' performed for VEVO DSCVR, which combined have amassed almost 200k views on YouTube.  

SIDE A: 
1. Happiness In Liquid Form  
2. Things I Thought Were Mine 
3. Maybe This Is Time 
4. Obvious Guy  
5. Wish I Was Younger  
6. My Best Friend feat. Coach Party 
 
SIDE B (EXCLUSIVE TO REISSUE): 
1. Only One 
2. Endlessly 
3. Happiness In Liquid Form (Live) (VEVO DSCVR Artists to Watch Session) 
4. Happiness In Liquid Form (Acoustic) (VEVO DSCVR At Home Session)

releases.title: Diplo
releases.label: Sweat It Out
releases.details: Diplo—the prolific artist's self-titled album and first full-length of electronic/dance music in 18 years—is the realization of a three-year deep dive into the house music that first blew Diplo's mind as a teenager and that he has now founded Higher Ground to champion worldwide. A titan of electronic music, he’s now turned his focus back to these roots. The album includes the Grammy-nominated “On My Mind” with Sidepiece, "Don't Forget My Love" with Miguel, “Looking For Me” and “Promises” with Paul Woolford and Kareen Lomax, “Don’t Be Afraid” with Jungle and Damian Lazarus and “One By One” with Elderbrook and Andhim—classic house records that have soundtracked clubs worldwide—as well as collaborations with Aluna, TSHA, Leon Bridges, Lil Yachty, Busta Rhymes, Seth Troxler, Amtrac, RY X and more. A special Australian export edition from Sweat It Out featuring a curated selection of remixes by Barry Can’t Swim, DJ Seinfeld, Andhim, and more. This 3x LP deluxe Trifold set is the exclusive physical home for these remixes. Each of the three discs comes in a unique color: Green, Red, and Blue.

releases.title: Greg Belson Presents: The House Of Beauty
releases.label: Celestial Echo
releases.details: Following his acclaimed gospel compilations, Greg Belson digs deeper into the private soul and R&B world with The House of Beauty — a stunning new compilation focused on independent releases tied to chicago’s HOB label. Beautifully remastered, this Celestial Echo release tells a story of DIY soul at its purest and Carmen Murphy’s legendary work. An RSD 2026 special that embodies the day’s spirit — discovering overlooked voices and celebrating the communities that brought us some of the best gospel soul. 1xLP, Picture Sleeve, Remastered.

The release features breakout singles ‘do you light up’ and ‘rock n roll’. And will follow after his first headlining sold-out shows at the Brixton Academy in London.

releases.title: KPop Demon Hunters (Soundtrack from the Netflix Film) - Saja Boys Edition (Record Store Day Exclusive)
releases.label: Republic
releases.details:
1 LP special effect vinyl featuring original art cover by official KPop Demon Hunters vis dev artist, Marion Bordeyne. Includes fold-out poster, sticker sheet, and 3 snapshot cards (3 of 12 versions). 

KPop Demon Hunters (Soundtrack From the Netflix Film) has taken over the world as a true pop-culture phenomenon. The biggest soundtrack of 2025, it has topped the Billboard 200 at #1 and is certified RIAA Platinum. Leading the charge is “Golden,” the #1 most-streamed release of 2025 globally, which dominated the Billboard Hot 100 for eight weeks—marking the longest #1 reign of the 21st century by a female group. Applauded by fans and critics alike, the film and soundtrack have received five GRAMMY nominations including Song of the Year, two Academy Award nominations including Original Song, three Golden Globe nominations including Best Original Song, and won two Critics Choice Awards, including Best Song for “Golden.”
Record Store Day Exclusive.

releases.title: Excerpts from Outside

releases.title: MTV Unplugged
releases.label: Legacy Rep
releases.details: x2 Black LP Vinyl - Tony Bennett’s Grammy-winning MTV Unplugged session to be released on vinyl for the very first time. Originally recorded live in New York City in April 1994, this landmark album showcases Bennett’s timeless interpretations of the Great American Songbook, backed by the impeccable Ralph Sharon Trio. This 2LP set, pressed exclusively for Record Store Day, features 21 unforgettable tracks, including classics like "I Left My Heart in San Francisco", "Fly Me to the Moon", and "Steppin’ Out With My Baby".

releases.title: Jazz In The Key Of Blue
releases.label: Chesky Records
releases.details: This is a limited-numbered edition, first time LP release of the 2009 Jimmy Cobb Quartet album 'Jazz In The Key of Blue' on 180g 'One Step Pressing' blue vinyl LP with an RSD exclusive expanded liner note. Originally released to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Miles Davis' Kind of Blue, the album stands as a profound statement from the legendary drummer of that historic session. On this record, Cobb is joined by Roy Hargrove on trumpet & flugelhorn, Russell Malone on guitar, John Webber on bass. Together with his own signature tasteful, swinging drumming, he crafts a masterclass in straight-ahead jazz. First issued on CD/SACD in 2009, the album has been out of print ever since.

releases.title: April/Lotus
releases.label: Polydor
releases.details: Rising star Rose Gray presents an exclusive 12” featuring two stand out original tracks from her recent deluxe album A Little Louder, Please, ‘April’ and ‘Lotus,’ backed with club-ready remixes from producers of the moment Daniel Avery and Sofia Kourtesis.

releases.title: Twenty Years Deep
releases.label: Brownswood
releases.details:
For Record Store Day 2026, Brownswood Recordings mark two decades of boundary-pushing independent music with Twenty Years Deep, a limited-edition 3xLP vinyl compilation celebrating the label’s rich, global catalogue and enduring influence. 

Founded in 2006 by broadcaster, DJ, and cultural tastemaker Gilles Peterson, Brownswood has spent the last 20 years championing forward-thinking artists who sit just left of centre: rooted in Afro-diasporic music, but never confined by genre. Twenty Years Deep is a snapshot of that journey: a carefully curated collection spanning the label’s early breakthroughs, cult classics, and defining moments. 

Pressed exclusively for Record Store Day on 3 piece coloured vinyl Twenty Years Deep brings together tracks that reflect Brownswood’s long-standing commitment to artistic freedom, musical lineage, and future-facing sounds. From deep jazz explorations and dancefloor mutations to global collaborations and genre-defying hybrids, the compilation captures the connective thread that has defined the label since day one: trust in artists and belief in music that lasts. 

Rather than a greatest-hits exercise, Twenty Years Deep functions as an archive and a statement documenting how Brownswood has maintained its own point of view. By following a highly instinctive approach to A&R the label has shaped music culture, introduced new voices, and built a catalogue that continues to resonate well beyond release cycles. 

Twenty Years Deep will be available exclusively at participating independent record stores on Record Store Day 2026, pressed as a limited-edition 3 piece vinyl release.

releases.title: We Are Not Live
releases.label: Charly Records
releases.details: 2026 Record Store Day Reprise of the 1968 album 'LIVE' by the 13th Floor Elevators. Panned at the time for being billed as "live" when in fact it was a compilation of previously recorded studio masters, outtakes and alternate mixes. The "very loud" crowd noise was overdubbed and was actually taken from a boxing match and wholly inappropriate for the purpose. Now, almost 60 years on, the album masters are available, in their original sequence, without the crowd noise, to be enjoyed in their full psychedelic splendor. Includes a pull-out giant 6-panel souvenir poster.

releases.title: Call On Me
releases.label: Central Station Records
releases.details: Few voices possess the immediate recognition and infectious soul of Starley, the Australian artist whose talent captured the world's attention. Her landmark hit, ‘Call On Me,’ is far more than just a song; it's a global phenomenon, boasting well over one billion streams and achieving platinum and gold accreditation in over 26 countries worldwide. Marking the 10th anniversary of the iconic ‘Call On Me’ in 2026, Starley is celebrating the milestone by releasing an exclusive, highly anticipated vinyl pressing for her global fanbase. This commemorative edition will be a stunning picture disc and full picture Sleeve, including essential remixes from Ryan Riback, Odd Mob, Dexcell, and Anton Powers.

releases.title: Little Feat
releases.label: Rhino
releases.details: Next in the lineup of foundational Little Feat albums to get the Rhino Deluxe treatment is the band's 1971 self-titled debut album. Releasing as a 2LP vinyl set exclusively for RSD 2026, it includes the original album, AAA-cut from original master tape, alongside a bonus disc of rare previously unreleased alternate versions and outtakes from their early recording sessions.

releases.title: Hot

releases.details:
Melanie B’s debut solo album “Hot” is released for the first time on vinyl for Record Store Day 2026.
A fusion of R&B and pop, the album features collaborations with producers including Jimmy Jam, Terry Lewis, Rodney Jerkins and Fred Jerkins III. Originally released in 2000, “Hot” includes singles “Tell Me”, “Feels So Good”, “Lullaby” and the UK chart-topping hit “I Want You Back” featuring Missy Elliott.
This limited-edition picture disc - in trademark leopard print - is a must-have item for fans of Melanie and the Spice Girls alike.

releases.title: Brightside
releases.label: V2 Records
releases.details:
With Brightside, Ziggy Marley delivers an album rooted in intention, sound and deep musical connection.

Released exclusively on vinyl (Orange vinyl) and CD for Record Store Day on April 18, 2026, this album will only arrive on streaming services at a later date. This makes Record Store Day the first and only place to experience Brightside in its purest form, before it is available anywhere else.

Designed with a physical-first philosophy, Brightside is meant to be heard as a complete audio experience. Ziggy recorded the album in 432Hz, a frequency often associated with meditation, balance and healing. To fully capture this specific sonic vision, his studio was rebuilt at the new Tuff Gong campus, allowing for warm, organic and earth-grounded tones.

Recorded with a live band, the songs on Brightside took on a life of their own during the sessions. The performances are expansive, immersive and deeply musical, emphasizing feel and atmosphere over convention. The result is an album that invites listeners to slow down, listen closely and connect with the music on a deeper level.

At its core, Brightside carries a message of healing, reflection and perspective. It is an album built around sound quality, intention and emotion, created to be experienced fully on vinyl or CD.

releases.title: Rapper's Delight DUB/The Message DUB
releases.label: Sanctuary
releases.details: Two stone-cold hip hop greats brought together on vinyl for the very first time. This special 12" release features the Dub mixes of 'Rapper's Delight' and 'The Message' on limited edition colour vinyl.

releases.title: RONIN: CYBERPUNK 2077
releases.label: Materia Collective
releases.details: Materia Collective proudly presents Angel Of Man RONIN: CYBERPUNK 2077, a striking new entry in the world of cinematic game-inspired music. Drawing directly from the cybernetic heart of Cyberpunk 2077, Angel Of Man crafts a bold sonic journey that merges industrial grit, electronic experimentation, and cinematic scope. This Record Store Day exclusive brings fans a 12-track album, including an unreleased, vinyl-only bonus track available nowhere else. From high-octane anthems like Extraction Action and The Heist to reflective soundscapes such as Outsider No More and Rite of Passage, RONIN: CYBERPUNK 2077 embodies the chaos, rebellion, and neon-soaked beauty of Night City. The album is pressed on a Limited-Edition 180g Katana CyberRed 1xLP, featuring a 12” premium vinyl jacket with cyberpunk-inspired original artwork designed exclusively for this release. Each copy is housed in a black poly-lined protective sleeve, making it a collector’s centerpiece for video game music fans, cyberpunk enthusiasts, and vinyl aficionados alike. With its mix of adrenaline-pumping rhythms and haunting electronic atmospheres, this release is both a standalone artistic statement and a love letter to the world of Cyberpunk 2077.

This seminal 2017 record introduced the world to the trio's signature sound, blending deep, atmospheric house with sun-drenched, indie-electronic pop. Featuring breakout tracks such as platinum-certified ‘Flow’ and fan favourites ‘Come Back To You’ and ‘I Hope You Get It.’ Previously only released on wax in their native Australia, this cherished album is finally available in the northern hemisphere for record store day.

releases.label: Dead Oceans

On Nov. 6th, 2025 Khruangbin released The Universe Smiles Upon You ii, the reimagined version of their debut album The Universe Smiles Upon You, on its 10-year anniversary. The new album features a new sequencing with every song re-recorded, all with various degrees of subtlety and musical reinterpretation. 

The original album had a secret bonus track that was featured on a JCD, and they’re replicating this approach by holding “M. Blanc” (entitled “Mr. White” on the original album) as the bonus track specifically for the JCD and RSD exclusive products.

releases.title: Can We Hang Out Sometime?
releases.label: Many Hats Distribution
releases.details:
Blending the punchy riffs of J-rock, the playfulness of indie rock, and the raw edge of pop-punk, Good Kid has crafted a sound that’s impossible not to move to. Their ability to spin clever lyrics and sticky melodies into high-energy tracks has turned casual listeners into hardcore fans across the globe.
Good Kid isn’t your typical rock band; they’re likely the biggest indie act you’ve never heard of. With more than 700 million streams across their catalog, a viral breakout single (“From the Start” amassed 1M streams in its first 24 hours and now boasts over 171M streams and a GOLD certification in Canada), and 2.8 million monthly Spotify listeners, Good Kid has built an exponential following, all while staying fully independent. They had seven infectious tracks featured in a MrBeast video (topping 300M views), earned them two JUNO nominations (including Breakthrough Group of the Year in 2024), and fueled sold-out tours across North America, the UK, and Europe.
With four popular EPs under their belt, Good Kid’s debut full-length, Can We Hang Out Sometime?, delivers the high-energy hooks and inventive riffs that have become a hallmark of their sound, while boldly pushing into new territory; longtime fans will find the signature Good Kid bangers they’ve come to love, but also hear the band exploring fresh textures, rhythms, and sonic twists in their grittiest offering yet.
The Collectable RSD version of their new record Can We Hang Out Sometime? Featuring a limited edition Marble Green vinyl, a uniquely coloured die-cut front cover that reveals a pullout paired printed innersleeve illustration. Also included: 3 surprise lore-based Tarot cards, Character-based sticker sheets with bespoke accessories, a multi-page video game-manual inspired booklet with lore and artwork easter-eggs, and a calendar. All wrapped up in a RSD specific Obi-strip.

releases.title: Compendium
releases.label: Trading Places
releases.details: Obscure British psych rockers Rupert’s People began in 1967 as Sweet Feelings, fronted by singer-songwriter/guitarist Rod Lynton. A debut single was issued by Colombia and after manager Howard Conder had the Fleur De Lys re-record the B-side as Rupert’s People, Sweet Feelings assumed the name. A handful of intense singles followed but the anticipated breakthrough never quite happened; this crucial compendium gathers the scarce recordings, including the Sweet Feelings tracks and sympathetic covers of the Small Faces’ ‘I Can Show You’ and the Stones’ ‘You Can Get It If You Really Want.’ ESSENTIAL LISTENING FOR PSYCH FANS!

releases.label: Submarine Cat
releases.details: The 2026 Mob Wife Mix of Alabama 3's 'Woke Up This Morning' lands on exclusive white vinyl for Record Store Day. Originally released in 1997, 'Woke Up This Morning' was written as a protest to domestic violence, inspired by the murder case surrounding Sara Thorton. After featuring as the iconic soundtrack to The Sopranos, 'Woke Up This Morning' has now been re-recorded featuring vocalist Zoe Devlin, touring member of Alabama 3, and remixed by Gus (Alt-J), Equalateral, and Porij.

releases.title: Red Moon
releases.label: Jazzed Out
releases.details: ‘Red Moon’ is Alannah’s second solo single and marks her first ever physical vinyl release. The song reflects on growth, misdirection and self-reconnection, told through a woman looking back at her younger self. Written on a quiet beach in the Algarve, under a striking red moon, the moment became the catalyst for the lyrics, carrying a deep, spiritual stillness into the music. Alannah is a 23-year-old singer-songwriter whose sound blends RnB, jazz and hip-hop with soulful, storytelling vocals. Influenced by artists such as Sarah Vaughan and Billie Holiday, she views songwriting as a form of emotional release and shared healing. With performances at iconic venues including Ronnie Scott’s and Pizza Express Jazz Club, her voice carries a timeless energy, full of heart, vulnerability, and quiet power. Stanley Hood’s remix reimagines ‘Red Moon’ into a moody Deep House cut. Alannah’s layered vocals float over warm keys, late-night percussion, and thick, club-ready production, shifting the emotional core towards the dancefloor while preserving the intimacy of the lyrics. Supported across specialist radio and tastemaker sets. Released as a Record Store Day exclusive on coloured 7" vinyl with full picture artwork. Strictly limited run. When it’s gone, it’s gone.

releases.title: BBC Radio sessions
releases.label: Broadcast Recordings
releases.details:
A selection of live versions of tracks from the band’s first three albums, recorded for ‘BBC Radio 6 Music’ in Media City, Salford and London Maida Vale Studios, in 2022, 2023 and 2025. 

Spanning various different chapters of Pale Blue Eyes…Fun, chaos, elation, nerves, all in the midst of tours, breakdowns, robberies and miles and miles on the road. 

The band have chosen their favourite tracks from the three different live sessions that they did for ‘The Marc Riley Show’ and ‘The Riley & Coe Show’. 

A great way of documenting and remembering the first few years of Pale Blue Eyes. The album will be released on limited edition red vinyl for RSD.

releases.title: Power Pop! American Power Pop for the Now Generation 1977-1981
releases.label: Soul Jazz
releases.details: Exclusive limited edition one-off pressing on heavyweight single red vinyl + download code. Soul Jazz Records’ new ‘Power Pop! American Power Pop for the Now Generation 1977-1981’ brings together a wealth of punk/power pop/new wave tunes from American bands that were all originally released in the USA on small and independent labels in the late-70s/early-80s.

releases.title: Gentle Tuesday / Imperial: The 1987 EP's
releases.label: Warner Music UK
releases.details:
Originally forming in Scotland in 1982, Primal Scream were key to the C86 indie scene in the UK. They were signed by Alan McGee to Elevation Records in 1987 for their debut album, Sonic Flower Groove. 

Featuring Bobby Gillespie on vocals Jim Beattie and Andrew Innes on guitar, and Robert Young on bass, the sound of their debut is very different to the dance orientated groove they pioneered in the 1990s. Very much influenced by Nuggets, psychedelic pop and garage rock of 1960s America, the album was preceded by two singles of their Byrds-infused indie-pop; ‘Gentle Tuesday’, released June 1987, and ‘Imperial’, released September 1987. Featuring a number of non-album cuts, ‘I'm Gonna Make You Mine’ was originally released by The Shadows of Knight, and Pete Townsend’s ‘So Sad About Us’ was originally recorded by The Who

releases.title: Nadia Reid with NZ Trio - Live at Old St Paul’s
releases.label: Chrysalis Records
releases.details:
This album comprises of a number of tracks recorded live at Old St Paul's in Wellington, New Zealand with NZ Trio, a chamber music trio based in NZ. Nadia sang an incredible array of her catalogue, including a song that has been released this year alongside her new album Enter Now Brightness, accompanied by a beautiful classical string arrangement. All of the tracks on the album have never been released before, digitally or physically, making it not only Nadia's first ever live album, but also first live album with new live arrangements!
 
Two of the tracks on the album include beautiful covers, one from Mazzy Star and another from New Zealand based Mahinārangi Tocker. 
 
The release will be accompanied by three extra special shows in London, Bristol and Manchester, with a string duo to accompany the tracks on the album.
 
The record will include a gorgeous Blue Denim vinyl, printed inner sleeve with words from Nadia and a QR insert to download the tracks!

releases.title: Amore Libero OST
releases.label: AMS
releases.details:
EXCEPTIONAL CINEVOX EXCLUSIVE FOR RECORD STORE DAY 2026!
THE FIRST SOUNDTRACK COMPOSED BY LEGENDARY FABIO FRIZZI RECORDED
IN 1974 BY GOBLIN’S “PROFONDO ROSSO/DEEP RED” FANTASTIC LINE-UP!

Amore Libero – Free Love marks the first film score composed by Fabio Frizzi, written in 1974 for the movie of the same name directed by Pier Ludovico Pavoni. Set against the exotic backdrop of the Seychelles, the film tells the story of Simo, a free-spirited young woman played by Laura Gemser in her cinematic debut, blending sensuality and the spirit of liberation so typical of the 1970s.
Frizzi’s score perfectly captures the film’s atmosphere, weaving together evocative melodies, funky grooves, and progressive textures — an elegant, psychedelic soundscape that reflects both the tropical setting and the film’s themes of freedom and desire. The recording features the Goblin in their classic line-up: Fabio Pignatelli (bass), Massimo Morante (guitar), Walter Martino (drums), and Claudio Simonetti (keyboards), with Vince Tempera handling arrangements and orchestral direction.
Long regarded as a true holy grail for collectors, now, for the first time ever, it is officially reissued on vinyl, bringing back to light a fundamental chapter in Italian film music and progressive sound. An essential record that merges Frizzi’s melodic genius with the visionary energy of the Goblin, Amore Libero – Free Love stands as a timeless document of an extraordinary era in Italian cinema and its music.
A Record Store Day 2026 exclusive / Pearly light blue vinyl edition / 30x30cm insert with extensive liner notes

releases.title: Were 'The Watchtowers'
releases.label: Yep Roc Records
releases.details: Dallas Good (of the Sadies) and Richard Reed Parry (of Arcade Fire) had been collaborating on their album Were 'The Watchtowers' for over a decade until Dallas Good unexpectedly passed away in 2022. Dallas' passing inspired Parry to find collaborators to help finish the album, including Neko Case, Buffy Sainte-Marie and Margaret Atwood (author of The Handmaid's Tale). These are the final recordings of Dallas Good and a testament to his musical legacy. The album will be pressed on limited edition colour vinyl. The final track "Not in This World" features a chorus of Dallas' friends and fans from around the world singing together on Dallas' final piece of recorded music, a fan-sourced song that will part of this album exclusively available first at Record Store Day.

Of these remasters, Needle Mythology co-founder Pete Paphides says, “The remastering (from Sean Magee at Abbey Road Studios) has dramatically revealed a depth and physicality to these recordings that casts new light on Robert’s intentions for these records.

releases.title: Grown Up
releases.label: Reservoir Recordings
releases.details: Danny Brown’s “Grown Up” is a cult-classic hip-hop single that captures everything fans love about the Detroit rapper—wit, grit, and unfiltered personality. Dropped in 2012, the track is built on Party Supplies’ playful, piano-loop beat that feels like a 90s throwback with just the right amount of bounce. Over it, Danny rewinds to his childhood, spitting about chipped teeth, scuffed sneakers, and the kind of rough edges that shaped his razor-sharp style. The single’s video, starring a pint-sized Danny lookalike raising hell across the city, turned the song into an underground sensation and fan favorite. “Grown Up” remains one of Brown’s signature moments—equal parts nostalgic storytelling and high-energy fun, proof of his ability to blend classic hip-hop sensibilities with his one-of-a-kind voice. This 7” includes the instrumental version as the b-side. Colored vinyl

releases.title: The Complete BBC Peel Sessions
releases.label: 4AD
releases.details:
2LP (Silver Vinyl) - German goth pioneers Xmal Deutschland - revered among British audiences in the early Eighties for their ominous and transfixing presentation of danceable darkwave, sung mostly in the German language - performed live for beloved DJ John Peel’s BBC Radio 1 program four times over the span of 1982 to 1985. Emerging from Hamburg's art-punk underground and often associated with the Neue Deutsche Welle scene, the band quickly found a devoted UK following when they signed to 4AD and extensively toured alongside label mates Cocteau Twins, Clan of Xymox, and Dead Can Dance.

Now, for the first time, their complete Peel Sessions recordings are collected in one place - available exclusively for Record Store Day as a 2×LP Silver Vinyl set. The 16-song anthology, newly remastered at Abbey Road Studios (2026), includes fan favourites "Incubus Succubus," "Mondlicht," "Geheimnis," and "Qual". This release features new artwork by Timothy O'Donnel and band photography by Jörg Bohm. Tracklisting: A1 Incubus Succubus, A2 Geheimnis, A3 Zinker (aka Stummes Kind), A4 Qual, B1 Sehnsucht, B2 In Motion, B3 Reigen, B4 Vito, C1 Mondlicht, C2 Tag für Tag, C3 Augen-blick, C4 Nachtschatten, D1 Polarlicht, D2 Der Wind, D3 Jahr Um Jahr, D4 Autumn

releases.title: Crisus Time
releases.label: Charly Records
releases.details: The mic reggae master returns! For the first time ever, I-Roy’s Crisus Time comes back to wax — fully remastered and restored to mark 50 years since its original release in 1976. A cornerstone of roots DJ culture, this long-lost treasure now steps forward again in a special anniversary edition made for true reggae heads and vinyl collectors. This exclusive Record Store Day release features a faithful replica of the original 1976 sleeve, plus a new printed inner sleeve with fresh liner notes by acclaimed reggae writer John Masouri and a full-page black-and-white photo of the man I-Roy — a fitting tribute to one of Jamaica’s most original voices. On Crisus Time, I-Roy delivers his trademark mix of wisdom, humor, and rebel poetry. From the streetwise sermons of “Hypocrite Blackout” and “Love Your Neighbor” to the Rasta calls of “African Tak” and “Don’t Touch I Man Locks,” he turns everyday truth into lyrical fire. Riding deep dub rhythms, his voice moves between meditation and proclamation — pure word, sound, and power. A true monument of the reggae DJ era, Crisus Time shines again — 50 years on — a timeless celebration of rhythm, roots, and I-Roy’s enduring message.

releases.title: The Singles Collection 1975-1979
releases.label: CINEVOX/AMS
releases.details:
FOLLOWING THE SUCCESS OF “THE OTHER HELL”, GOBLIN ARE BACK FOR RECORD STORE DAY 2026 WITH AN EXCLUSIVE COMPILATION OF SINGLES RELEASED BETWEEN 1975 AND 1979!
For the very first time on vinyl, this compilation gathers together all the singles released by Goblin during their golden era between 1975 and 1979, a journey that begins with the explosive, legendary debut Profondo Rosso, a true chart phenomenon of its time, and reaches the rare Amo Non Amo, passing through unforgettable milestones of Italian film music and progressive rock.
The collection opens with Profondo Rosso and Death Dies, taken from the soundtrack of Dario Argento’s masterpiece that catapulted Goblin to fame, blending dark atmospheres, virtuosity, and a unique sense of cinematic tension. It continues with Roller and Snip Snap, drawn from the instrumental album Roller (1976), a record not tied to any film, yet considered a cult cornerstone of Italian progressive music for its intricate structures and expressive power.
Chi? and Chi? - Parte Seconda follow; two tracks originally composed as the theme for a 1976 RAI television show, which saw Goblin bring their unmistakable sound to a different medium, experimenting within a shorter, punchier format.
Next comes Suspiria with its haunting counterpart Blind Concert, from the soundtrack of Argento’s 1977 horror classic. This remains one of Goblin’s most iconic and unsettling works, where music becomes an active narrative force: hypnotic, percussive, and filled with eerie vocal layers that made it a cornerstone of horror soundtracks worldwide.
From Il Fantastico Viaggio del Bagarozzo Mark (1978) come Un Ragazzo d’Argento and Opera Magnifica, two tracks that highlight the band’s more conceptual and visionary side, a move away from cinema toward a self-contained narrative and progressive experimentation.
The single Yell stands as another late-decade gem. Originally composed as the opening theme for the RAI television series “Sette storie per non dormire” (1978), it captures Goblin’s ability to merge rock energy with electronic pulse, proving their versatility far beyond the horror realm.
The compilation closes with Amo Non Amo and Funky Top, taken from the soundtrack of the 1979 film Amo Non Amo, one of the group’s lesser-known but fascinating cinematic works.
Far more than a simple anthology, The Singles Collection 1975–1979 maps the evolution of Goblin’s sound, from the worldwide success of Profondo Rosso to their most mature and experimental phase. It finally restores to vinyl a body of work that had long been scattered across rare 45 rpm releases, offering fans and collectors a complete, vivid portrait of one of Italy’s most inventive and influential musical ensembles.
A Record Store Day 2026 exclusive / White vinyl edition with gatefold cover and extensive liner notes.

Experience the full power of King’s explosive 1975 performance at the Jazz Pulsations Festival in Nancy, France that captures the Texas blues legend at his fiercest. King roars through a high-energy set of blues, funk, and soul-drenched grooves, backed by a razor-sharp band and fuelled by his searing guitar tone and powerhouse vocals. This performance, is now presented in its complete form - fully restored and available to the public for the very first time. The audio was transferred directly from the original stereo tape reels at INA and mastered by Matthew Lutthans at The Mastering Lab, ensuring stunning sound quality that brings every note to life. This limited edition deluxe 180g vinyl 3-LP box set on includes rare, previously unpublished photographs from the festival and extensive liner notes.

For me it’s nice to have a time of year and RSD collective, to make a album for, where I can approach things differently, with record shops and album-lovers in mind first (before streaming and playlists) and step outside of my Emika blueprints, meaning fans can collect a different side to my work this way. After having a chat with Jim Barr (from the band Portishead) about using studios more as spaces for improvising, not only to hire one to finish pre-written songs in, I saw it both as an invitation and challenge, to spend a week in his studio, jamming around. ‘Emika - Untitled’, produced for RSD 2026, in Jim Barr’s studio (Portishead). releases.title: Weapon Of Choice
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details:
Available for the first time on vinyl, Weapon of Choice is an earlier take on The Cult’s album Choice of Weapon, produced by Chris Goss, before Bob Rock came on board to help finish the album. Pressed on silver effect vinyl and housed in a mirrorboard sleeve.

Known by fans as the prequel to Choice of Weapon, the collection stands on its own: more immediate, raw, and a rare look into The Cult’s creative process at a pivotal moment. Tracks like “Supreme” (an early take on “Honey From a Knife”), “The Bones” (a precursor to “For the Animals”), and “Gibraltar” (the foundation of “The Wolf”) showcase the band reconnecting with their signature heavy-atmospheric sound while pushing into new territory.

Strictly limited to 3,000 copies worldwide.

This is a 2026 Record Store Day exclusive.

releases.title: No Lube, So Rude
releases.label: Kill Rock Stars
releases.details: Limited Picture Disc Edition for Record Store Day 2026. UK/EU tour dates in April 2026. A brash, unapologetic blend of electronic, dance, punk, industrial, and pop music, No Lube So Rude exists at the intersection of the personal and the political, where the body serves not only as a sexual and spiritual vessel, but also as the front line in a battle for basic human rights. Peaches’ lyrics are bawdy and explicit here, laced with biting sarcasm and clever wordplay, but they’re also surprisingly vulnerable, offering up a candid look in the mirror from a post-menopausal queer icon reckoning with a society that’s come to expect silence, if not outright erasure. The result is a deliberately provocative exploration of identity, sexuality, and bodily autonomy from a trailblazer, a singular work of emotional and sonic alchemy that balances the poetic and the profane in equal measure as it transforms all the friction and frustration of modern life into joy and transcendence.

releases.title: Lady Be Good: Live in Europe with The Birdland All-Stars
releases.label: Unique Jazz
releases.details: The 1956 Europen sessions with Miles Davis and the Birdland All Stars lineup (with Lester Young and MJQ) see their 70th anniversary. New and exclusive vinyl only pressings will be available for RSD26 on heavweight colour edition gatefold LPs. Miles Davis broke up his ‘First Great Quintet’ in 1956 as a consequence of John Coltrane’s severe heroin addiction. Miles, having recovered from his own addiction, fired Coltrane and drummer Philly Joe Jones in March 1956 due to their struggles with the drug. At the same time Miles was struggling with the racial tensions and prejudice he suffered in the U.S., as well as his growing infamy and bad reputation domestically. Miles had previously toured Paris in 1949 and relished the experience of performing in front of a more accepting audience. In order to advance his career and enjoy some respite from his turbulent home, Miles accepted an offer to tour Europe with a new group of musicians. They were named the ‘Birdland All Stars’, and included Lester Young, the Modern Jazz Quartet, and many other top-tier jazzmen. These recordings are the only ones in history to feature both Miles and Lester, and took place over several concerts from the tour.

collaborations with artists like Jarvis Cocker and the creation of 
underground club anthems, Crooked Man is back to reimagine his own 
classic tracks. This EP delivers four brand-new remixes of The All 
Seeing I’s Picked Eggs & Sherbet, blending his signature offbeat grooves 
with dark, hypnotic energy. A must-listen for fans of leftfield house, 
experimental dance, and the rich legacy of Sheffield's electronic 
music culture.

releases.title: Penn State 29 June, 1974
releases.label: Panegyric
releases.details:
Live King Crimson multi-track recording of live set from June 29th, 1974, at Penn State University

Available on vinyl for the first time, exclusively for Record Store Day 2026

2LP set cut by Jason Mitchell at Loud Mastering and pressed on 200-gram audiophile vinyl

Gatefold sleeve with new sleeve notes from King Crimson biographer Sid Smith

Robert Fripp: Guitar, Mellotron & Devices

David Cross: Violin, Viola, Mellotron, Electric Piano
John Wetton: Bass, Lead Vocals
Bill Bruford: Drums & Percussion

To coincide with the releases of “Starless & Bible Black” in March 1974, King Crimson set out on a run of shows that

many fans consider to be that line-up’s peak with the late music critic John Kelman (All About Jazz) describing them

as being at their “heaviest and most guitar-centric version of Crimson to date” where “even 24 hours represented a

significant difference in how this group approached form-based material”.

With the rapid growth of CD in the 1980s came an equally rapid growth in bootlegging and by 1992 there were over

120 different King Crimson bootlegs – many focusing on poor quality recordings of the 1973/74 touring band whose

reputation among fans and influence on a generation of musicians continued to grow.

Thus prompting the band to release their own multi tracked live performances.

Long requested by fans for a vinyl release, Penn State is being made available on 200-gram double vinyl for the first

time exclusively for Record Store Day in April 2026, ‘1974 Penn State University’ also includes the recording of

21st Century Schizoid Man from the band’s Central Park gig 2 days later which was to be this line-up’s last incarnation

before becoming a trio to start recording the ‘Red’ album.

Previously, the album was only available on CD through Robb Johnson's Irregular Records label. Now, for the first time, it is being released as a limited-edition vinyl by VINYL STAR RECORDS, featuring a distinctive red pressing. ‘Devil on the Wind’ combines the bands famed live ferocity and undiminished lyricism to create an essential rock folk hybrid very much relevant in these volatile modern times. This essential release highlights the heart and soul of The Men They Couldn’t Hang - as someone once said, The Clash jamming with The Byrds!

releases.details: First released in 2014 - and with the original vinyl now fetching hundreds on Discogs - Aaron Freeman’s (aka Gene Ween) 'post-Ween' band debut is finally reissued for Record Store Day 2026, in an exclusive orange & purple split-colour pressing. FREEMAN is a heady mix of psychedelic, bluesy-art rock refracted through Gene’s Pop filter. The content is heavier, almost spiritual, compared to his previous work in Ween, yet the album epitomises Gene’s talent for the sardonic and his weird warped brilliance.

releases.title: Look Outside Your Window
releases.label: Look Outside Your Window

Over the years, the existence of this project has seen coverage in outlets including Vice, Revolver, NME, Kerrang!, and countless others, and the fans have only grown louder in their demand to hear this album. 

Now over 15 years later, the fans will finally get to experience it for themselves.

releases.title: Tighten It Up
releases.label: Gold Coast
releases.details: A criminally overlooked P-Funk treasure from 1981, Tighten It Up captures Chicago’s funk underground at its raw, electric best — with none other than Frankie Knuckles contributing as mixing consultant, giving the record an unmistakable dance-floor edge ahead of the house era. Long out of print and increasingly hard to find, this beautifully remastered RSD edition brings the Gold Coast classic back into circulation with restored artwork. An essential 2026 pick that shines a light on a missing link between P-Funk, disco, and early Chicago club culture — exactly the kind of deep, collector-grade rediscovery Record Store Day was made for. 1xLP, Picture Sleeve, Remastered, Transparent Red Vinyl.

releases.title: While You Wait
releases.label: Winding Road Records
releases.details: Reissue of the legendary Deep House album While You Wait by Nottingham group, Schmoov! celebrating the 25th Anniversary of the release. Available for the first time since its initial release in 2001 & highly sought after on the second-hand market, with the only copies available selling for £70+. Presented here on special purple vinyl, giving a new generation of vinyl collectors an opportunity to own a piece of UK Deep House history.

releases.title: Naquela Base
releases.label: Far Out Recordings
releases.details: An RSD vinyl only exclusive of a track from Nicola Conte's next album. A cover of Joao Donato's dancefloor jazz classic Naquela Base. The track will only be released digitally at a later date in late 2026 and will not appear on the vinyl version of the album, so will remain exclusive to this limited edition 7 inch.

releases.title: Buckle
releases.label: 100% Records
releases.details: Buckle is 10! The classic track is presented for the first time on split blue/pink 7”, featuring new artwork from the music video, with a newly recorded Brown Bar version of the track on the b-side (which features touring partner Sean McVerry).

releases.title: The Tiberi Tapes: A Preview Of The Mythic Recordings
releases.label: Verve US
releases.details:
Among the most fabled and mythologized recordings of the last 65 years, the private recordings of John Coltrane’s group made by musician Frank Tiberi in the early 1960s have long been the subject of jazz world rumor and intense speculation. 
Tiberi followed Coltrane into clubs in New York and Philadelphia, capturing the otherworldly music being created nightly on his portable tape recorder. 
For the first time ever, these recordings will be made available in September 2026 as part of John Coltrane’s Centennial celebrations. 
For Record Store Day 2026, we’re offering a single LP preview of these historic recordings - a project that will undoubtedly grow and enhance the legend of John Coltrane.

releases.title: The Seduction
releases.label: LANTERN REC.
releases.details: Reissued for the first time on vinyl, the debut album of the post punk mancunian band Ludus (originally released in 1981), guided by the famous visual artist, performance artist and musician Linder Sterling. With one extra track! Gatefold double vinyl!

releases.title: Bye Bye Love
releases.label: Culture Factory (France).
releases.details: The Everly Brothers helped shape early rock & roll with their flawless harmonies and unforgettable melodies. This Bye Bye Love compilation gathers their most essential recordings, including “Bye Bye Love,” “Wake Up Little Susie,” “All I Have to Do Is Dream,” “Cathy’s Clown,” “Lucille,” and “Crying in the Rain.” Fully remastered for optimal sound, every track highlights the duo’s unique blend of country, pop, and rock. Presented on Translucent Yellow Vinyl with the CD included, this edition is strictly limited to 1,500 copies, offering fans a rare opportunity to rediscover the timeless magic of The Everly Brothers.

releases.title: St. Cecilia - The Elektra Recordings
releases.label: Rhino / Elektra
releases.details: In 1969 and 1970, the band that would become Blue Öyster Cult recorded two albums for Elektra Records, but neither was released at the time. The first LP is the original 1969 master, cut from tape for the first time by Chris Bellman at Bernie Grundman Mastering. The second LP is a compilation of the 1970 sessions and single mixes appearing on vinyl for the first time.

releases.title: Arise
releases.label: REAL ROCK RECORDS
releases.details: Recorded in 1983 at Music Mountain, Jamaica, this is one of the last recordings by the late Hugh Mundell. The production and mixing were a collaboration between Mundell and Dennis Bovell. Originally released in 1988 on the Atra label, this is a classic addition to any collection. Remastered and featuring a new cover design.

releases.title: To All New Arrivals
releases.label: Commercial Group
releases.details: x2 Transparent Yellow LP Vinyl - 20th anniversary pressing - 1st since original release, first on colour and first as a 2LP

releases.title: Reflections
releases.label: ROUND RECORDS
releases.details:
One of Garcia’s most artistically unified statements of harmony, affirmation, and joy celebrates its golden anniversary with an expanded 3xLP set. Reflections (50th Anniversary Edition) presents the remastered original studio album, recorded with the Grateful Dead and the Jerry Garcia Band – plus two bonus LPs featuring studio outtakes, jams and four previously unreleased live recordings. The collection is housed in a tri-fold mirror board jacket and pressed in a limited edition of 5,000.

releases.title: The Way I Should
releases.label: Yep Roc Records
releases.details: With The Way I Should, Iris DeMent stepped boldly into new territory, delivering a collection that balanced her fierce lyrical conviction with tender vulnerability. Released in 1996, this third studio album from the revered Americana singer-songwriter expanded on her folk and country roots, blending sharp political commentary with deeply personal storytelling. In celebration of the 30th anniversary of Iris Dement's album The Way I Should, Yep Roc Records is releasing the album on vinyl for the first time. The album is remastered by Mike Westbrook of Material Mastering and is pressed on Summer Sky color vinyl.

releases.title: Movin' To The Beat
releases.label: NIA
releases.details: Following their underground hit “Hooked On Your Love,” the Aleem brothers — Taharqa and Tunde-Ra Aleem — returned in 1981 with this unstoppable boogie-disco single. Teaming up with vocalist Corky Hodges, they delivered a dancefloor gem packed with soaring vocals, rich production, and a massive, instantly-addictive chorus that defined early-’80s club brilliance. Long sought-after by boogie collectors, a mint original regularly tops £100 on Discogs — if you can even track down a clean copy. This reissue finally brings a rare classic back within reach. Pressed on Yellow Vinyl.

releases.title: Flux (Deluxe)
releases.label: A.G. Records
releases.details:
Celebrate Alison Goldfrapp’s Top 15 album Flux 
with this strictly Limited Edition deluxe vinyl release. Pressed here on a never-before-available physical format, and with no future repress planned, this edition is a true collectible for fans and archivists alike.

Created for RSD, this exclusive 16-track edition is pressed on lilac 12" vinyl and features a brand-new sleeve image unique to this release. Six of the tracks make their physical-format debut, making this the most immersive version of Flux ever offered.

releases.title: Faces For Radio - The BBC Sessions 1979-1982
releases.label: West Village Music Management
releases.details: An exclusive ultra clear coloured vinyl LP containing newly remastered versions of the 15 tracks recorded by the band across four BBC Sessions that were broadcast between 1979 and 1982. Included are 4 previously unreleased tracks that were recorded for The Mike Read Show.

releases.title: Dear Children of Our Children, I Knew / Cremisan
releases.label: International Anthem
releases.details: Dear Children of Our Children, I Knew is a new EP recorded by Alabaster DePlume in the middle of his March 2025 US tour. DePlume had been playing shows with bassist Shahzad Ishmaeli and drummer Tcheser Holmes, performing music of his critically-acclaimed album A Blade Because A Blade Is Whole (released March 2025). The trio's rapport was so strong that DePlume chose to use an off day in Brooklyn to record this collection of instrumentals, which were inspired by experiences he had sharing, performing and improvising off the music of A Blade for audiences across the US. Dear Children in a sense serves as an epilogue to A Blade, which makes it all the more appropriate that the B side of its RSD-exclusive vinyl release contains the three song EP Cremisan: Prologue to A Blade, which was released (digital only) in fall 2024. As with almost everything that DePlume has put forth in recent years, the connection of this work to Palestine is deep: the Cremisan EP itself was recorded in Palestine; Dear Children includes samples of children recorded in Bethlehem; and the album's cover art depicts wheatpaste posters of a drawing made by a 13 year old boy from Gaza (used with permission).

releases.title: The Tension Between
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details:
After a triumphant return with 'Pillars' — The Sun (4★), Classic Pop (4★), and Rolling Stone UK “Album of the Week” — Jack Garratt presents The Tension Between: a brand new collection of songs written and recorded in the months following 'Pillars', and released for the first time exclusively on vinyl and CD for Record Store Day.

Across 9 brand new tracks, this release captures Garratt at his most fluid and instinctive. The result feels like the bridge between past and future, and a deeper insight into the recording sessions that brought him back after nearly quitting.

This release celebrates Jack’s creative resurgence. 
For collectors, this represents a never-before-heard chapter from one of the UK’s most innovative writer-producers — a limited release that won’t be available digitally until later in 2026.

releases.title: Big Fig Wasp
releases.label: Having Fun Records
releases.details: Having Fun continues off from where We Are Busy Bodies left off and brings you a bee (pollinator) shaped picture disc record compiling live songs by King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard from their Bootlegger Series. This record is a picture disc shaped like the face of a bee and features live staples Big Fig Wasp, Great Chain of Being, Grow Wings & Fly, among others. Having Fun and We Are Busy Bodies have previously issued a wax cylinder record, a record that plays forwards and in reverse and at two speeds, a buzzsaw shaped record, a record with a hidden 7", a record with an 80-piece puzzle, one that glowed in the dark, and crazily (to some), others beyond this list. $1 from each sale will benefit a to be determined pollinator charity.

releases.title: Live in Manchester
releases.label: Ignition Music
releases.details:
"This live album was recorded at the band's epic homecoming show at Manchester’s Co-op Live Arena on their hugely acclaimed Pink Cactus Cafe arena tour in 2024.
Since the release of their debut album St. Jude in 2008, Courteeners have built a reputation of one Britain’s best live bands and this album captures the euphoric energy of the band and their fans as one.
This exclusive double LP is limited to just 2,000 copies, individually numbered and pressed on heavyweight vinyl."

releases.title: The Undone Is Done Again
releases.label: Fire Records
releases.details: 1000 copies on Yellow vinyl. A brand-new musical project from two pioneers, released for the very first time as part of Record Store Day 2026. This is music that feels both ancient and immediate - haunting, beautiful, and defiantly different on a new EP from Tanya Donelly - co-founder of Belly, Throwing Muses, and The Breeders - and Chris Brokaw, guitarist/singer for the legendary Come and longtime collaborator with Codeine, Thurston Moore, and The Lemonheads. A beautiful reimagining of the centuries-old form of the madrigal for the modern era. Pressed on colour vinyl.

releases.title: What Dance Is This? UK Post-Punk Dancefloor 1979–1983 Vol. 2
releases.label: LANTERN REC.
releases.details:
Straight from an alternative dancefloor, a recollection of stone cold classics from huge & influential post-punk pioneers ! They called it white funk once, but here you can even catch latin, dub and clubby influences, a mutant disco manifesto from a series of British magicians such as Normil Hawaiians, Glaxo Babies, Playgroup, C Cat Trance, Suns of Arqa & Prince Far I and many more. Presed on clear vinyl. Enjoy the wild party! 'OBEDIENCE' - Normil Hawaiians; 'KEEP BEAT' – Vee VV, 'FOR THE LIFE OF ME' – Spit Like A Paint, 'ARTY-FACT' – Group Therapy, 'HYPNOTISED' - C Cat Trance; 'QUIT THE BODY' – The Chicken Granny –
BED BOUND SAGA – Machine Gunn Hogg And Co
HOGGS MIGHT FLY – Playgroup
SHAKE (THE FOUNDATIONS) – Glaxo Babies
G.D. Magik - Suns of Arqa feat. Prince Far I

releases.title: The Last Mardi Gras
releases.label: Rhino
releases.details: Studio recordings from Baton Rouge and Memphis from 1971 and 1972. Unreleased until 1991, this is the album's first appearance on LP. 2-LP 140g Purple & Green Vinyl (LP1 Purple, LP2 Green)

releases.title: Inbred
releases.label: Amigo / AWAL
releases.details: Florida-born multimedia artist Ethel Cain wrote, produced, and mixed Inbred from the church basement she called home in Indiana while constructing the EP. Cain is the creative force behind the entire project with the EP originally released in 2021. Inbred will be pressed on vinyl for the first time for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: Lick My Decals Off, Baby (Deluxe Edition)
releases.label: Rhino / Atlantic
releases.details: Deluxe edition of the classic 1970 album from Captain Beefheart and The Magic Band. This limited edition 2LP vinyl set features the original album, recut from the original master tapes at Bernie Grundman Mastering, plus an additional LP with previously unreleased instrumental versions and alternate takes from the original album sessions.

releases.title: My Old Man
releases.label: Puddlebrook Records
releases.details: Privately issued in the UK in 1976 and recorded in a single twelve-hour session at Spaceward Studios, Bob Hughes’ ‘My Old Man’ is one of the lost treasures of British folk’s DIY underground. Marking its 50th anniversary in 2026, the album captures this poet, singer-songwriter, and behavioural scholar at his creative peak - delivering intimate, melancholic folk and folk-rock songs that tackle social conflict, historical memory, and deeply personal narratives. A defining UK private-press rarity and among the rarest and most valuable folk records of its era (less than 100 original copies in existence). This reissue has been sought after for decades by underground private-press collectors. Official one-time reissue copies available for RSD26.

releases.title: Just Tell Me You Love Me: A Tribute To Fleetwood Mac
releases.label: UMR/Concord
releases.details: The all-star indie rock tribute to the legendary music of Fleetwood Mac is making its vinyl debut! The album features bands and artists such as HAIM, MGMT, Tame Impala put their signature sound to Fleetwood Mac classics of all eras of the band, including “Dreams,” “Rhiannon,” “Landslide,” and more. This limited edition 2-LP set has been pressed on translucent sea blue vinyl exclusively for Record Store Day.

releases.title: Pinnacle
releases.label: Time Traveler Recordings
releases.details:
Buster Williams’ 1975 "Pinnacle" is a masterful blend of spiritual jazz, post-bop, and early fusion, showcasing the bassist’s vision as a composer and bandleader. With a stellar lineup—including Woody Shaw, Sonny Fortune, Onaje Allan Gumbs, and Billy Hart—the album features richly textured arrangements, deep grooves, and expressive solos. 

Remastered & Cut AAA directly from the original analog tapes by Matthew Lutthans at The Mastering Lab. Pressed on 180g vinyl at Optimal Media and housed in Stoughton Old Style® Tip-On Jackets. Including an insert with newly written liner notes by Mike Flynn and Barney Fields with a rare photograph by Raymond Ross.

releases.title: Paper Route Illuminati
releases.label: Paper Route EMPIRE
releases.details:
2xLP, Gatefold Jacket, Red Marbled Vinyl. PAPER ROUTE iLLUMINATi is the compilation album from Paper Route EMPIRE, the label founded by late Memphis legend, Young Dolph, and home to the equally iconic Key Glock and an impressive roster of additional artists including Snupe Bandz & Big Moochie Grape. Including the hit songs, "Talking To My Scale," "I Do This," & "Mister Glock 2," as well as deep cuts like "Broccoli & Cheese," this album is a must have for Southern rap fans and encapsulates a time when PRE was at the height of their game, shortly before Young Dolph's untimely passing. 2xLP pressed on Red Snake Eyes Galaxy vinyl, and housed in a gatefold jacket. Long Live Young Dolph.
