releases.title: Sunburnt
releases.label: Fire Records
releases.details: 1000 copies on Orange vinyl. The late, great Martin Phillipps circa 1996. Following the self-combustion of the original Chills in the States, a set of gloriously introspective songs recorded in the UK with Fairport’s Dave Mattacks and XTC’s Dave Gregory when the new line-up were turned away at Heathrow. A Phillipps solo album by default, that led to a hiatus before The Chills’ glorious return in 2013. Back on vinyl for the first time in 30 years with revitalised artwork and pressed on colour wax. “The Chills’ Martin Phillipps leaves a legacy of melancholy brilliance.” The Guardian.

releases.title: Famous Monsters
releases.label: Rhino Atlantic
releases.details: Limited edition color vinyl reissue of the long out of print fifth album from The Misfits originally released in 1999. Featuring the tracks "Saturday Night", "Scream" and "Helena". 1LP on purple and green splatter vinyl.

releases.title: Oh! What A Lovely War (+ Six Day War 7
releases.label: Seelie Court
releases.details: Darkly psychedelic, politically charged, and utterly rare. This one-off psych-rock classic from 1971 still resonates with its anti-war edge. Originally released on the Chess subsidiary Cadet Concept, 'Oh! What a Lovely War' is the sole album by Liverpool’s Colonel Bagshot. The band, initially known as “Colonel Bagshot’s Incredible Bucket Band,” began as a six-piece before condensing into a four-piece, and produced an intense series of 7-inches between 1969 and 1973, earning a devoted cult following. The album’s standout track, “Six Day War,” achieved renewed recognition when DJ Shadow sampled it (renamed “Six Days”) on his 2002 album The Private Press, and later in 2018 by Mahmut Orhan. Seelie Court’s 2026 anniversary reissue comes pressed on psychedelic splatter vinyl with original gtefold sleeve artwork, expanded with additional liner notes and an obi strip. Audio remastered. An additional 7" single containing two unreleased recordings of “Six Day War” recorded by Brian Farrell (and featuring Ollie Halsall) comes packed inside. An unsophisticated must-have for adventurous psych-rock collectors.

releases.title: Foreigner 4 Live Tour 1981-1982
releases.label: Rhino / Atlantic
releases.details: A breakout from the 44th Anniversary Deluxe Edition of 4 released earlier this year, Foreigner 4 Live Tour 1981-82 explores the bands explosive live performances, recorded live during their early 80's world tour to support the original album release. The new double LP RSD Exclusive vinyl includes shows at Anaheim Stadium in California, the Odeon in Birmingham, England, and at Westfalenhalle in Dortmund, Germany.

releases.title: One For The Road
releases.label: BMG Rights Management (UK) Ltd.
releases.details: The Kinks' epic 1980 live album ‘One For The Road’ specially reissued on stunning zoetrope vinyl. Featuring the best moments from the original double album, this collector’s edition includes an exclusive fold-out poster. Pressed on Zoetrope vinyl.

releases.title: Beauty Tips, Hair Care and Fuck the Patriarchy
releases.label: Manic Merch
releases.details: Best of from legendary punk band Lunachicks. Contains tracks from all of their studio albums.

releases.title: Jazz Dispensary: Magia Brasileira
releases.label: UMR/Concord
releases.details: Jazz Dispensary comes to Brazil! Our groove alchemists tunneled deep into the vaults to pull together a smoking spread of Samba sizzlers, airy and intoxicating vocal-jazz dreamscapes, funk-drenched jams, and guitar lines so catchy they practically shimmer in the sun. Featuring legends like Bola Sete, Flora Purim, Dom Um Romão, João Donato, Paulinho da Costa, this batch of aural Caipirinha is pure musical jet fuel. Pressed on “Brazilian Shimmer” green / yellow / gold vinyl. Original artwork by illustrator Fernanda Peralta.

releases.title: Palace Springs
releases.label: ATOMHENGE
releases.details: An exclusive 35th anniversary Record Store Day transparent orange vinyl edition of this classic album, never reissued on vinyl since the album’s original release in 1991.

releases.title: Nublu Dance
releases.label: Nublu Records
releases.details: Languishing in obscurity since its original digital and CD only release, Nublu Dance returns with a meticulously curated vinyl only release that captures a pivotal moment in electronic music history. Originally issued as a single compilation in 2008, this essential document showcases the extraordinary talent incubator that was Club Nublu during its legendary 2000s Lower East Side era. The collection features remixes and productions from artists who were integral to Nublu's groundbreaking creative community—many of whom have since become defining voices in contemporary electronic music. What began as underground experimentation in a dimly lit club in the Lower East Side has evolved into a lasting testament to the power of artistic community and creative risk-taking. Now receiving the deluxe treatment it has always deserved, the Nublu Dance Series is being reissued as a physical release of the full compilation on gatefold double LP with two vinyl only bonus tracks from the Istanbul Sessions: Night Ride Remixes release. This vinyl releases represent more than just music—it is a historical artifacts capturing the early creative output of electronic music pioneers during their formative years. This pressing will be strictly limited with no reprints planned, making it an instant collectible for both electronic music enthusiasts and cultural historians. For Nublu, this reissue serves as both celebration and validation of the club's commitment to nurturing underground talent. The fact that these artists continue to innovate and influence electronic music nearly two decades later proves the lasting impact of the creative ecosystem Nublu fostered during one of New York's most fertile periods for experimental music. This is electronic music history, pressed to vinyl and ready to inspire a new generation of underground innovators. Collectively, the Nublu Dance series captures the club ethos in a remix form while showcasing Nubluʼs signature international underground sound—perfect for vinyl lovers, DJs, and collectors alike.

releases.title: Havana Garden
releases.label: Pop Fiction Records
releases.details: This is the first ever vinyl single release for Bird. "Havana Garden" gives an enticing glimpse of what is to come on her limited edition vinyl album due for release 5th June 2026.Recorded partly in Austin Texas it is also the first time Bird releases a duet and not just any duet but a female duet performing with the song's co-writer Texan born and based acclaimeed singer songwriter Jane Ellen Bryant. The song itself was written on the first ever "Florence Austin Alliance song writing retreat which Bird hosted at her studio in Tuscany. On this single Havana Garden Bird says, "I had an idea for the lyric after reading a newspaper article about a cemetary in Cuba where people go to worship miracles rather than mourn the dead...Legend has it the bodies of a woman and child buried together in the tradition of the day wth the baby at the feet of the mother had to be exhumed and on doing so they discovered the child had moved up to the mother's arms...and so now locals go in praise of love and miracles and leave offerings at the cemetary...And so Jane and I worked that story into this song.. when we wrote the final lines together I actually burst into tears and then Jane did, sometimes you get the lyric just right and it strikes something deep inside you..."

releases.title: Play Records: 30 Years at Play
releases.label: Play Records
releases.details: Celebrating three decades of cutting-edge electronic music, iconic Canadian Mellefresh’s Play Records marks its 30th anniversary with a premium collector’s edition vinyl release. Founded in 1996, Play Records was the launchpad for much of deadmau5’s early catalogue as he rose to global stardom. This special anniversary edition dives deep into the Play Records archives, showcasing previously unreleased gems, exclusive tracks, and rare remixes and covers spanning the label’s storied history. The release comes as a 2×LP transparent yellow vinyl, housed in an iconic artwork sleeve with photography marking the label’s rich legacy.

releases.title: Best of Hank Wilson
releases.label: Dark Horse Records
releases.details: The Best of Hank Wilson focusses on Leon Russell's country alter-ego. This will be the first vinyl pressing of this best of collection, highlighting this lesser-known area of Russell's catalogue.

releases.title: Tina Harvey
releases.label: Trading Places
releases.details: During the early 1970s Tina Harvey was hot property. The singer was based in Slough, west of London, and after making an impact on the nightclub scene she recorded this sole long-player, released on pop impresario Jonathan King’s UK Records imprint in 1973. The wide range of cover tunes on the album betrays her underpinning influences, with a spirited take of Martha & the Vandellas’ ‘Nowhere To Run’ taking its place alongside renditions of Dylan’s ‘Like A Rolling Stone,’ the Stones’ ‘Have You Seen Your Mother Baby, Standing In The Shadows’ and the Spinners’ ‘Working My Way Back To You.’

releases.title: Live from Köln 1976
releases.label: Demon Records
releases.details: First time ever vinyl release for this incredible live concert from Rainbow’s debut world tour and documenting one of the band’s first ever shows in Europe, at Cologne’s Kölner Sporthalle on 25th September 1976. Released on 3LP with each disc pressed in a different colour of the Rainbow (Translucent Red, Yellow and Blue) and Newly Mastered by Andy Pearce & Matt Wortham When Rainbow finally landed in Europe for their debut live shows there, it was on the back of both the albums ‘Ritchie Blackmore’s Rainbow’ and ‘Rainbow Rising’ having charted, so the band were playing sold out venues, and what a band… with the line up consisting of Ritchie Blackmore, Ronnie James, Cozy Powell, Jimmy Bain and Tony Carey As one of the cornerstones of British Rock, Rainbow, led by the never-predictable but ever-astonishing guitarist, Ritchie Blackmore, became synonymous with some of the most well regarded and popular charting Rock songs of the seventies and eighties. This show recorded on the bands Rainbow Rising tour in 1976 in Cologne Germany, features stone cold classics such as ‘Stargazer’ and ‘Man on the Silver Mountain’. This live album has only been available on CD pressings originally made 20 years ago, both as a single concert / as part of the Japan only 6-CD Box Set Deutschland Tournee 1976. Now nearly 50 years on from the original concert, the recording makes it’s debut appearance on a vinyl format with the audio Newly mastered by Andy Pearce & Matt Wortham

releases.title: Remixes
releases.label: East West
releases.details: A collection of amazing remixes from the likes of David Morales, Perfecto, Mousse T and more of many of Simply Red classics such as Stars, Money’s Too Tight (To Mention), Something Got Me Started on a limited edition transparent red and transparent blue vinyl.

releases.details:
25th Anniversary Edition of Sophie Ellis-Bextor’s debut album Read My Lips – Featuring exclusive voice recordings incorporated throughout the album plus rare bonus tracks and reimagined artwork. 

Releasing exclusively as part of Record Store Day 2026 on limited edition red transparent glitter 2LP, each copy will be numbered and housed in a single sleeve with reimagined album cover art, plus printed inner bags featuring new unseen imagery compared to previous reissues.

releases.title: South Shore Commission
releases.label: South Street Disco
releases.details: The essential debut album from Chicago’s disco-funk pioneers, featuring the timeless “Free Man,” returns fully remastered from the tapes of Tom Moulton for RSD 2026. Produced by Philly soul legends Bunny Sigler and Bruce Hawes, this record bridges Chicago’s raw energy with Philly’s orchestral elegance. Essential for any collector serious about the roots of disco and dancefloor culture — an all-killer, no-filler LP that sounds fresher than ever today. Remastered and Redesigned labels and sleeve, Transparent Purple Vinyl.

releases.title: Live In New York
releases.label: UMR/EMI
releases.details:
Available on vinyl for the first-time, Live-In New York captures Corinne Bailey Rae’s full self-titled debut album performed live at New York City’s Webster Hall in 2006. The set includes live versions of “Like a Star” and “Put Your Records On”, both Grammy-nominated singles. 

Released exclusively for Record Store Day, this limited-edition pressing is issued on purple marbled vinyl to celebrate the 20th anniversary of Rae’s triple platinum album, which has sold over four million copies worldwide.

releases.title: The Bootleg Sounds of Marshall Crenshaw 1984-1989
releases.label: Yep Roc Records
releases.details: Marshall Crenshaw has dug through his archives and curated a compilation of previously unreleased recordings, demos and live songs recorded between 1984 and 1989. Songs include a cover of Buddy Holly’s “That’ll Be the Day,” featuring Garry Tallent and Max Weinberg; demo versions of songs that would appear on his third and fourth studio albums; live recordings from 1986-87; and other lost recordings Marshall unearthed from his studio. This LP is being released for the first time as a Record Store Day Exclusive color pressing of 1,500 copies worldwide.

releases.title: Live at the 100 Club
releases.label: 100% Records
releases.details: The late Northen Soul legend Nolan Porter joined forces with UK-based soul heroes Stone Foundation in 2011 for a series of landmark gigs. For the first time on vinyl, the performance at London’s legendary 100 Club is now available for Record Store Day. Pressed on white vinyl, the performance boasts Nolan’s timeless classics Keep On Keepin’ On and If I Could Only Be Sure alongside other favourites from his career, as well as Stone Foundation’s very own track Tracing Paper. The release captures a thrilling collaboration at a time before Stone Foundation would themselves go on to considerable success, and is a reminder of a celebratory night that lives long in the memory of all who were lucky enough to be present.

releases.title: Reflections
releases.label: Culture Factory (France)
releases.details: Reflections - 1981 studio album which is widely considered one of his best releases, praised for its potent social commentary & blend of spoken word with a jazz-infused sound. It features the single 'B Movie' known as Scott-Heron's "smartest political rap ever" and backed by the Midnight Band. Past GIL SCOTT-HERON releases from Culture Factory USA for RSD include Winter In America & From South Africa to South Carolina which sold over 4,000 EACH in the US. This Vinyl has been out of print and completely unavailable. This deluxe vinyl package includes: OBI side spine, original art work, printed inner sleeve and Purple marble-effect color vinyl.

releases.title: The Confessions Tour Live
releases.label: Warner Records
releases.details: The Confessions Tour is a live album from Madonna, which features performances from her 2006 “Confessions On A Dancefloor” tour. Originally released on CD in 2007, this 13-track album will be released as a 2LP Splatter vinyl for Record Store Day 2026

releases.title: Short & Sweet (Expanded Edition)
releases.label: On-U Sound
releases.details:
On-U Sound are proud to present a first time vinyl reissue of one of the true gems from the On-U Sound catalogue, ‘Short and Sweet’ by Little Annie.

Originally released in 1992, Short and Sweet has been out of print on vinyl ever since, and is now in high demand amongst discerning record collectors. For RSD 2026 it is presented as a limited edition, 2LP expanded reissue featuring all the tracks from the original album (including underground crossover hit ‘I Think Of You’), as well as a further 6 tracks produced by Adrian Sherwood, including two never before released on Vinyl.

This limited edition 2LP is produced on colour vinyl exclusively for Record Store Day, with painstakingly restored artwork including never before seen photos, and Little Annie’s story in her own words in an exclusive interview.

This reissue presents a unique opportunity to own and discover a long out of print title from a true underground legend.

releases.title: Navajo Rug (35th Anniversary)
releases.label: Jerry Jeff Walker
releases.details: In celebration of its 35th Anniversary, Jerry Jeff Walker’s Navajo Rug is now available on vinyl for the first time ever. A fan favorite, the LP features newly remastered tracks like “Navajo Rug,” “If I’d Loved You Then,” and Jerry Jeff’s ode to one of his favorite baseball players, “Nolan Ryan (He’s A Hero To Us All).” Pressed on exclusive colorway for RSD.

releases.artist: Various Artists - Monstercat and Firaga Records
releases.title: UNDERTALE (10-Year Anniversary Remixes)
releases.label: Monstercat, Firaga Records
releases.details: To celebrate a decade of Undertale, Firaga Records and global EDM powerhouse Monstercat are thrilled to unveil a special Record Store Day variant of UNDERTALE (10-Year Anniversary Remixes). This exclusive 1xLP vinyl features an all-star lineup of Monstercat legends, including ØneHeart, Pegboard Nerds, Haywyre, Tokyo Machine, No Mana, alongside Firaga favorites such as VGR, Roborob, RoBKTA, Vector U, and PrototypeRaptor. Featuring 10 electrifying remixes of iconic tracks from the game, this release fuses deep respect for Toby Fox’s original compositions with bold, dancefloor-ready energy. The result? A once-in-a-generation VGM remix album that reimagines Undertale through the lens of cutting-edge electronic sound. Pressed on an eye-catching purple vinyl variant and packaged in an exclusive Record Store Day design, this edition is crafted to impress collectors and appeal to longtime fans alike. More than a tribute, it’s a celebration of one of the most influential indie games ever made—and a keepsake worthy of its legacy.

releases.title: Mutemath
releases.label: Rhino
releases.details: Color vinyl reissue of the long out of print 2006 debut album by Mutemath in celebration of its 20th anniversary. Limited Edition 2LP set; featuring the tracks "Typical", "You Are Mine", "Chaos" and more.

releases.title: Acoustic Hits (25th Anniversary Edition)
releases.label: UMR/Polydor/Fiction
releases.details:
‘Acoustic Hits’, the companion to 2001’s ‘Greatest Hits’ collection. Recorded at Olympic Studios, London in August 2001. 

The collection, newly remastered by Robert Smith, features acoustic reimaginations of all 18 songs on 'Greatest Hits', including ‘Boys Don’t Cry’, ‘A Forest’, ‘Just Like Heaven’ and ‘Friday I’m In Love’. Available on 2LP silver bio vinyl for the first time. 

Supporting War Child with a £1 donation from every sale.

releases.title: What's Heaven Without You / Swallowtail
releases.label: Republic
releases.details: 7” double single including "What's Heaven Without You,” a tribute to David Lynch and “Swallowtail” a new original track. Pressed on black vinyl, this is a RSD exclusive piece.

releases.title: We Are They Who Ache With Amorous Love
releases.label: Fire Records
releases.details: 500 copies on Lemon Yellow vinyl. Back on vinyl for the first time in over 25 years. Renowned as one of Kurt Cobain’s favourite albums and not available on vinyl since its original release in 1990, an experimental improv collage of tunes old and new, haphazardly dissected for maximum impact. Kurt: “I like to listen to Jad Fair and Half Japanese with headphones on, walking around shopping malls — in the heart of the American culture. I just think that, if people could hear this music right now, they’d melt.” Pressed on colour vinyl. “One of the longest running art-punk bands in history.” The Quietus.

releases.title: Cold Hard Truth
releases.label: Rhino / Asylum
releases.details: George Jones' 1999 return to traditional country music, his first album with Asylum Records. Produced by Keith Stegall, the album features strong, original honky-tonk ballads and raucous tunes, reminiscent of Jones' classic recordings. Cold Hard Truth is one of Jones' strongest albums in nearly two decades, offering a consistent, high-quality listening experience.

releases.title: Restless
releases.label: Loud Records
releases.details: It's only appropriate that Xzibit's highly anticipated, and often-delayed, Restless concluded hip-hop's millennial melting pot. After all, Xzibit's association with Dr. Dre and his Aftermath regime attached very lofty expectations to Restless; X was publicly anointed as the next MC expected to blow up. Surely, with Dre as executive producer and guest shots from Eminem, Snoop Dogg, and Dre himself, Xzibit was virtually assured of acquiring the mainstream success that eluded him on previous efforts (At the Speed of Life and 40 Dayz & 40 Nightz). Thanks largely to Dre's knob-twisting input, Restless became aural kin to Dre's own 2001 comeback vehicle, as the head-nod factor is immediately established on "Front to Back," the heavenly synth stabs "X," and "Get Your Walk On." The main flaw in Restless' formula lies primarily with Xzibit's extensive list of guest collaborators. While contributions from Dre ("U Know"), Snoop ("D.N.A."), and Eminem ("Don't Approach Me") are all welcomed, appearances from DJ Quik and KRS-One, among many others, take the focus off Xzibit's formidable lyrical boasting, which precludes Restless from forming a desired level of cohesiveness. On "X," Xzibit pledges to "Rearrange the game with my rugged sound," and he periodically delivers on that promise. However, it would have taken nothing short of a masterpiece for Xzibit to appease hip-hop's finicky masses.

releases.artist: Various Artists from Curaga Records and Chill Ghost Records
releases.title: Video Game LoFi: Pokémon Lullabies
releases.label: Curaga Records
releases.details: Curaga Records is thrilled to present a special Record Store Day release celebrating the 30th anniversary of Pokémon in 2026. Video Game LoFi: Pokémon Lullabies - Deluxe Edition brings together two respected labels—Curaga Records and Chill Ghost—to produce a carefully curated collection of lo-fi and sleep-inspired Pokémon remixes. This 1xLP vinyl features 12-15 standout tracks selected from a larger 50-track digital album, representing the most enchanting and relaxing reinterpretations of music across the Pokémon franchise. With lush textures, warm tape-saturated drums, gentle jazzy undertones, and ethereal chillhop arrangements, this album transforms iconic Pokémon melodies into serene lo-fi experiences perfect for relaxation, study, or simply revisiting beloved childhood memories. Artists from both Curaga Records and Chill Ghost bring their signature production styles to the project, combining deep respect for the original compositions with innovative lo-fi interpretations. The album is packaged in a poly-lined protective sleeve with custom cover art designed specifically for this release by ArtbyGalen and Save Point, finished in a smooth matte for collectors and fans alike. This Record Store Day exclusive vinyl is a must-have for Pokémon enthusiasts, lo-fi collectors, and video game music fans, offering a tangible keepsake from one of the biggest cultural anniversaries of the decade.

releases.title: Live at Get Together 2025 for War Child
releases.label: Gravity
releases.details:
A special 2 track release from Divorce's set at Get Together, Sheffield, 17/05/2025. 

Including a live version of Heaven is a Long Way featuring Neighbourhood Voices - a local all-female identifying choir.

All proceeds from sales of the record will go to War Child who are the official charity partner of the festival. 

The packaging will feature photography from the day, 2 live recordings and etching on the reverse of the record.

releases.title: Congo Ashanti 2025 Remaster
releases.label: VP / Greensleeves
releases.details: First repress of a 1979 European cover colour vinyl g/fold sleeve yellow vinyl with red splatter. Emerging onto the worldstage via Lee Scratch Perry's 1977 masterpiece Heart Of The Congos, the group established a unique cache in the international reggae market. Cedric Myton, Watty Burnett, and Roy Johnson struck out on their own to produce Image of Africa and Congo Ashanti, both released in 1979. Each album is remembered for a distinct studio sound, more mainstream than Scratch's hazy experiments and in line with the late 70s golden era. Standout tracks include "Youth Man," "Days Chasing Days," "Hail The World Of Jah," and "Thief Is In The Vineyard." Featured players include Ernest Ranglin, Sly & Robbie, and Tommy McCook. The reissue features the images by acclaimed photographer Antoine Giacomoni. Newly remastered with liner notes and rare images.

releases.title: Lo-Files
releases.label: RCA
releases.details: x2 Black Recycled LP Vinyl in a die-cut cover sleeve - Bring Me The Horizon expand their sonic universe with the release of ‘LO-FILES’, a 23-track album of lo-fi reinterpretations from across their celebrated catalogue of music. This unique project sees tracks from every era including 2013’s Sempiternal through to 2024’s POST HUMAN: NeX Gen, transformed into laid-back, atmospheric reinterpretations by some of the most respected names in the lo-fi space, including No Spirit, Drxnk, HM Surf, and more. 2 x Black Re-vinyl, with a Die Cut Cover Sleeve and 4 page folded insert.

releases.title: crybaby
releases.label: AWAL
releases.details: crybaby was Lil Peep's third solo mixtape and the first body of work that Gus made in the studio with producers that he met online and had previously communicated with only via email, Twitter and texts. Featuring the breakout hit "white tee", Gus was branching out and experimenting with new musical styles including samples from The Postal Service, Brand New, Oasis, Modest Mouse and more. A special 10 Year Anniversary RSD Edition will be pressed for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: Live in Japan 1987 -FUKUI VOL.1-
releases.label: SOLID / TOYOKASEI
releases.details: A timeless treasure from the legendary trumpeter’s second visit to Japan will be released for RSD 2026 on deep-blue vinyl!! (Vol.1). In 1986, jazz icon Chet Baker made his miraculous debut in Japan, promising fans, “Let’s meet again soon.” Just one year later, he kept that promise—returning in 1987 for a series of unforgettable performances. This album captures the magic of the first set from his June 6th live show in Fukui, delivering the raw intimacy and lyrical brilliance that only Chet could conjure.

releases.title: Relics Of Tree Worship (In Dub)
releases.label: Balance
releases.details: Chant Artist Collective are an all star dub collaboration featuring Lee 'Scratch' Perry, Gaudi, Youth (Killing Joke), Kermit (Black Grape), Don Letts (B.A.D/6 Music). This is a one off coloured vinyl pressing double LP for Record Store Day.

releases.title: Guillotine Theatre
releases.label: Jungle Records
releases.details:
‘Guillotine Theatre’ was the debut album from Cuddly Toys, first released only in Japan in 1979, and then a revamped version in the UK in 1980. Cuddly Toys are the glam-punk band who evolved from the London glam-shock punk band Raped, and often noted for their version of a David Bowie/Marc Bolan unreleased co-write, Madman. Cross-dressing in an era when it was outrageous, their hot-panted Japanese drummer ‘Paddy Phield’ helped them gain fans in his home country. Not on vinyl since the original releases, this double-album version is extended with a whole side of the different Japanese album mixes, two tracks omitted from the UK version, and three 1980 demos from the same line-up. A limited edition in red vinyl, with an obi-strip like the import copies of the Japanese album. An album of Raped recordings was released by US label Puke N Vomit Records in 2024. Singer Sean Purcell died in 1996. A Japanese version of the band, as Cuddly ToyZ led by Paddy, has released an album and regularly gig around Japan.
Introvenus, Brain Saviour, Join the Girls, Wolf, Madman, Universe, Slow Down, Astral Joe. Alien, My Commando, Full Circle, Alien, Guillotine Theatre, Timewarp; Japanese mixes: Introvenus, Madman, Universe, Astral Joe, Full Circle, You Keep Me Hanging On, Front Page News; demos: Sound of the Silence, Holocaust, Bring on the Ravers.

releases.title: Ibiza Classics - The B Sides
releases.label: Ministry
releases.details: Transparent Orange coloured LP Vinyl - A collection of tracks from Pete Tong, Jules Buckley and The Heritage Orchestra’s Ibiza Classics project, this release brings together for the first time on vinyl the B-sides from the project and features remixes and reinterpretations from Eats Everything, Tale Of Us, Kolsch, Riton, Elderbrook and more of classic tracks from the Balearic Island’s rich history.

releases.title: Live In The New World - Berlin '76
releases.label: Madfish
releases.details: A stunning newly discovered unreleased live performance from SAHB in Berlin 1976 coinciding with the release of the 21 CD box 'Good Evening Boys & Girls'. 180g

releases.title: Live at the Jazz Showcase
releases.label: Resonance Records
releases.details: AHMAD JAMAL — At the Jazz Showcase is the first ever release of piano legend Ahmad Jamal's trio featuring bassist John Heard and longtime drummer Frank Gant captured live at Joe Segal's Jazz Showcase in Chicago, IL on March 20-21, 1976. The limited-edition 180-gram 2-LP (and 2-CD) set was mastered from the original tapes by engineer Matthew Lutthans at The Mastering Lab in Salina, KS, and pressed at Quebec's boutique audiophile pressing plant Le Vinylist. The deluxe package includes newly curated liner notes by Jamal scholar Eugene Holley, Jr., plus interviews with rapper/DJ/producer Pete Rock, Joe Segal's son Wayne Segal and more

releases.title: Happy By My Side (7
releases.label: Seelie Court
releases.details: Indian psych-rock pioneers The Flintstones - Rhett May and Clayton Saunders, who both grew up in Calcutta orphanages - helped ignite India’s underground psych scene. Their rare, earliest single, "Happy By My Side / Be Mine" (1968), was originally released on EMI India and is now signed to the underground Seelie Court label. This sunny, whimsical, and slightly eccentric 7” will return for Record Store Day 2026 as a facsimile edition, complete with the original psychedelic picture sleeve - the only surviving copy. Super rare and out of print for six decades.

releases.title: The Catalyst Files Compiled By Rainer Trüby & Miche
releases.label: PANORAMA
releases.details: Compiled by Rainer Trüby & Miche, this collection dives deep into the soulful, spiritual, and jazz sound of LA’s Catalyst Records. A PANORAMA special for RSD 2026, The Catalyst Files celebrates the label’s rich history and deep catalog that has been championed by so many DJs including Gilles Peterson and Patrick Forge over the years. Packaged as a 2xLP with gatefold in homage to the original Catalyst releases, liner notes from Andrew Jervis and insert. This is an essential for RSD 2026. 2xLP 180g Heavyweight Vinyl, Gatefold Sleeve, Insert, Liner notes from Andrew Jervis.

releases.title: Good Money (Jagz Kooner's 'The Midnight Circus' Remix)
releases.label: Strange F.O.L.K. LLP
releases.details:
Jagz Kooner's hypnotic 'Good Money -- The Midnight Circus remix' is a dazzling mash up of styles and chance meetings.

After seeing Kula Shaker on tour in the UK playing with Ocean Colour Scene, Jagz was knocked out by their epic psych rock soundscapes and the infectious bhangra grooves which power through Good Money, (performed by the UK's legendary Johnny Kalsi of the 'Dhol Foundation'). As the remix evolved, more exotic vibes were added, including a shredding sitar by Lionel Pezzano of 'Bhopal Flowers, who Kula Shaker played with in Canada, during a recent North American tour. 

The remix's title, 'Midnight Circus', from the lyrics, is also a nod to British psych heroes The Pretty Things, as well as Crispian Mill's story concept of the 'Winged Boy', that is woven throughout the band's album 'Wormslayer’.

releases.title: Live at Oil Can Harry's
releases.label: Catalyst
releases.details:
This Ahmad Jamal record returns for its 50th anniversary. Originally released on the Catalyst label in 1976, 'Live at Oil Can Harry’s' captures the pianist's August 1975 performance at the legendary Vancouver venue, which was a hub for live music from 1966–77. Ahmad Jamal plays here in quintet format. A masterclass in subtlety, swing, and melodic invention.

Long out of print in the US and UK, this reissue arrives on color vinyl in a hand-numbered gatefold sleeve with new artwork. Carefully remastered for pristine sound - this is a limited edition collector’s exclusive. Only available for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: Little House EP
releases.label: Parlophone
releases.details:
Rachel will be bringing the 'Little House' EP to vinyl for the first time, with a beautiful green recycled vinyl edition of the EP. This will include the full EP tracklist including 'What A life' and the currently unreleased 'Little House' (All tracks will be released prior to the vinyl release). Little House, The critically acclaimed EP, on vinyl for the first time, exclusive to Record Store Day 2026.

Limited Edition 1 x 12" Recycled green 140g vinyl.

releases.title: Slang
releases.label: UMR/Mercury
releases.details:
Slang was Def Leppard’s sixth studio album, released on 14 May 1996. It was the first album with new material to feature new guitarist Vivian Campbell. The album marked a musical departure from their signature sound and was produced by the band with Pete Woodroffe. 

For the first time, this Record Store Day 2LP release is personally curated by Joe Elliott and features B-sides and rarities from the time. The package is presented on pink vinyl with brand new enhanced artwork.

releases.title: Acoustic Live
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details:
Recorded during their sold-out acoustic tour of 2019-20, Acoustic Live captures Turin Brakes at their most open and unfiltered (no overdubs or production tricks here..). These performances strip the songs right back, highlighting the band’s outstanding songwriting and harmony vocals. Featuring their top 5 hit “Pain Killer (Summer Rain)” alongside a selection of fan favourites and a few deeper cuts. The album was recorded and mixed by the band's dear departed friend (and long-time sound engineer) Simon Holliday.
Acoustic Live is dedicated to both Simon, and all the amazing audiences who made this one of the band's favourite tours of the last 25 years.

This one off limited edition double coloured vinyl is housed in a gatefold sleeve with exclusive photos from the tour. 500 copies only worldwide.

releases.title: Analogue 20th Anniversary Deluxe Edition
releases.label: Rhino (Pure)
releases.details: Analogue is a-ha's eighth studio album, originally released in late 2005. To celebrate its 20th anniversary, a deluxe 2-CD edition will be released featuring 21 bonus tracks—15 of which are previously unreleased—including b-sides, remixes, demos, and alternate versions. Includes the hit singles, Celice, Analogue (All I Want) and Cosy Prisons. It charted internationally, hitting #1 in Norway and top 30 in several other countries. The album was produced by a-ha and Martin Terefe, mixed by Flood, and features backing vocals from Graham Nash. The audio has been remastered by Bill Inglot, and this release marks the album's first appearance on vinyl.

releases.title: Flying Teapot
releases.label: Charly Records
releases.details: Remastered from the original BYG Records tapes and cut for the first time ever at half-speed at the UK’s world-famous Stardelta Studios by Grammy Award–winning mastering engineer Lewis Hopkin, this exclusive RSD 2026 edition features a deluxe gatefold sleeve, archival artwork, and a 16-page booklet exploring the storytelling and mythology of the beloved Radio Gnome Invisible saga. Released under BYG Records - the original label that recorded the album before licensing it to Virgin - this definitive deluxe reissue delivers the best sound quality Flying Teapot has ever had: a true cosmic upgrade for Gong’s mind-bending masterpiece. Originally unleashed in 1973, Flying Teapot kicked off the eccentric Radio Gnome Invisible trilogy, introducing the wild, otherworldly universe of Gong. Here reside the Pot Head Pixies, space-faring creatures who ride interstellar teapots and transmit transcendent messages via Radio Gnome Invisible. At its core, the album is a surreal fusion of psychedelia, jazz improvisation, and anarchic humour, propelled by Daevid Allen’s visionary madness. Featuring the cult anthems “Radio Gnome Invisible,” “Flying Teapot,” and “Zero the Hero,” this edition resurrects Gong’s signature blend of absurdity and brilliance - now with stunning clarity that reveals every swirl of synth, every playful whisper, every glimmer of cosmic chaos. Half-speed mastered. Fully teapot-powered. Out exclusively for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: Caminho De Esperança Coladance 80
releases.label: Charly Records
releases.details: The Cape Verdean masterpiece returns—remastered, restored, and ready to set dancefloors alight once again. This Record Store Day, vinyl lovers and world music fans can finally get their hands on Caminho De Esperança Coladance 80 by Cabo Verde Show. First released in 1980 and long out of print, original copies have become collector’s treasures, fetching hundreds of dollars. Now, for the first time ever reissued on vinyl, this radiant fusion of Latin and African rhythms explodes onto limited-edition Sunset Orange Splatter vinyl. Formed in Paris in the late 1970s, Cabo Verde Show blended traditional Cape Verdean roots with global dancefloor energy. On Caminho De Esperança, the band reached their creative peak, delivering timeless tracks like “Coladance 80,” “Nova Coladeira,” and “Terra Longe” — each glowing with life, love, and exile’s bittersweet beauty. A hidden gem reborn, Caminho De Esperança remains one of the most exhilarating Latin-African dance albums of its era — a timeless celebration of rhythm, hope, and Cape Verdean soul.

releases.title: First and Last and Always (Japanese Remix)
releases.label: Warner Music UK
releases.details: Previously released on vinyl in Japan in 1985, this version of The Sisters Of Mercy’s debut album features alternative versions of Black Planet, No Time To Cry, A Rock And A Hard Place and First And Last And Always. It has been newly remastered from the Japanese masters and pressed on black ice vinyl.

releases.title: Words of Wisdom and Hope
releases.label: Merge Records
releases.details: Long OOP collab album from two indie rock institutions.

releases.title: Three Songs
releases.label: Kemado
releases.details: Three Songs, originally issued in 2004 by goated purveyors of heavy sound The Sword as a limited, homegrown CD-R featuring the first demos the band ever recorded and sold at shows around Austin, TX, arrives on vinyl for the very first time. Featuring early versions of tracks that would later appear on their landmark debut album Age of Winters, this remastered edition of Three Songs is pressed on Black Ice vinyl with an epic Mike Moses illustration etched on the flip.

releases.title: Live At The Budokan
releases.label: Parlophone
releases.details: blur’s first official live album, Live At The Budokan, was originally released in Japan back in 1996 on CD only. To celebrate its 30th anniversary, Live At The Budokan is released on this year's Record Store Day - Sat 18th April on double coloured vinyl.

releases.title: Going...Going...GONE!
releases.label: AWAL
releases.details: Hemlocke Springs’ debut EP going...going...gone! captures the singular voice of one of pop’s most inventive new artists—a kinetic blend of eccentric bedroom-pop sensibility and razor-sharp songwriting. Powered by the viral success of “girlfriend” (75M streams) and “heavun,” the EP solidified hemlocke as a left-of-center force capable of fusing internet-era with with timeless hooks. This RSD edition of the EP would mark the first time the physical product is available at independent retailers!

releases.title: Harmony Corruption
releases.label: Earache Records
releases.details: For Napalm Death, Harmony Corruption was an act of both reconfiguration and redefinition. Line-up changes beckoned as the eighties became the nineties, with Mark ‘Barney’ Greenway installed as vocalist, and Jesse Pintado and Mitch Harris as guitarists. With their new personnel, they forged a lacerating transfiguration of their sound. Having already written their names in metal’s history books as pioneers of grindcore, their third album saw them bridge the gap between that and death metal, still bristling with a febrile sense of fury, but with greater maturity and control. Despite a divisive initial reaction, it remains a bold new frontier in their catalogue – and the album that gave metal the powder keg of a track that is ‘Suffer The Children’. Three and a half decades on, its game-changing ferocity is being honored with a Record Store Day reissue, pressed on Blue and Red Merge vinyl complete with a stunning new alt artwork.

releases.title: Calling Card
releases.label: UMR
releases.details:
For Record Store Day 2026, a limited-edition half speed master of Rory Gallagher's 'Calling Card' album, which celebrates its 50th Anniversary this year. Originally released in 1976, Rory's sixth studio album is one of his most celebrated and diverse albums. It has been remastered by Frank Arkwright and the half speed master cut by Miles Showell at Abbey Road Studios. 

Available on 180g black vinyl as a Record Store Day 2026 exclusive.

releases.title: Live at The Hordern Pavilion (Sydney, NSW) 2025

releases.details: Spacey Jane play their biggest Australian headline shows to date, with (3) SOLD OUT nights at the legendary Hordern Pavilion. The band recorded and filmed the performances and we want to release a live album from the shows of the band’s career spanning 75 minute set list filled with fan favorites and songs from their latest album ‘If That Makes Sense’.

releases.title: Party 4U
releases.label: Atlantic Records
releases.details: For the first time, Charli will release ‘party 4 u’ as a single on vinyl. This pressing will be limited edition, available as 7” crystal clear vinyl, with an etched b side

releases.title: Live In Hammersmith 1979
releases.label: Demon Records
releases.details:
First ever official vinyl release for this incredible live concert from Status Quo at their loudest and best in 1979 recorded at the Hammersmith Odeon, London. Restored and newly mixed by the band’s Archivist Andy Gamble from tapes found in Francis Rossi’s library. Exclusively pressed on Translucent Red 2LP for Record Store Day.

HEAR THE QUO – LIVE AND LOUD AS NATURE INTENDED

Recorded at the legendary Hammersmith Odeon on 27th June 1979 as part of the bands ‘If You Can’t Stand The Heat’ Tour, this is regarded as one of the most sought-after live shows from the band and shows Status Quo at their loudest and proudest.

Featuring stone cold classics including ‘Rockin’ All Over The World’, ‘Down Down’, ‘Roll Over Lay Down’ and many more

releases.title: Songs Of Protest and Anti Protest
releases.label: Poppydisc
releases.details: Sought-after 60's psych rarity on vinyl. Orange Colour vinyl.. "Songs... is a work of schizophrenic beauty, by an artist given to regular LSD fuelled drives off LA landmarks" - Mojo Chris Lucey...the man who never was..... star of one of the most mysterious, rabidly collectable and expensive west coast folk-rock albums of all....A monster on Ebay, revered by Julian Cope, and buzzing through every Psychedelic website on the net...Produced by Marshall Lieb, Phil Spector's Teddy Bears collaborator, sounding like Arthur Lee demos backed by a punk version of Tim Buckley's band, sung and written by a man who worked with The Rolling Stones, Frank Zappa, Kim Fowley, P.J. Proby, Lowell George, and Curt Boettcher among other luminaries, but still managed to fall through the cracks of history Bobby Jameson.....subject of the most lavish and expensive Billboard ad supplement ever.....(for which the invoice is still outstanding)......star of "Mondo Hollywood" and best remembered among LA scenesters for jumping off the roof of the Riot House on Sunset and walking away.......a glimpse of that Mondo Sunset Strip underbelly that never really got represented at Monterey.....On the mysterious Surrey Records, released under a pseudonym, and boasting a blurred snapshot of Brian Jones jamming in a club on the Strip as it's front cover.. with a jazzy version of Bobby's song "Girl From The East", better known as recorded by Garage-meisters The Leaves...what was going on here God only knows.....But a West-Coast Classic from the Twilight Zone.....yes indeed..

releases.title: Alternate Atlantic Crossing
releases.label: Atlantic / Rhino
releases.details: Experience Rod Stewart's pivotal 1975 album in a new light with Alternate Atlantic Crossing, featuring ten rare alternate versions that reveal the raw, evolving sound of his famous transatlantic leap. Highlights include an emotional I Don't Want To Talk About It and Too Much Noise, the explosive early version of Stone Cold Sober. Get your copy now on coloured vinyl!

releases.title: On A Back Porch , Vol 3
releases.label: RBD2171
releases.details: Dogfish Head Brewery & Grateful Dead invite you for another round of good times On A Back Porch. Support indie record stores while enjoying easy-listening live Dead and easy-drinking beer. Limited Edition, 180-gram LP. Produced for release by David Lemieux.

releases.title: Live In Los Angeles 90
releases.label: Commercial Group
releases.details: Transparent Purple LP Vinyl. Previously only available on CD as part of the 50 Heavy Metal Years Of Music boxset, this transparent purple vinyl edition captures Judas Priest's performance at the Foundations Forum, Los Angeles on 13th September 1990 on their Painkiller tour.

releases.title: The Best of The 12
releases.label: Prelude
releases.details: D Train delivered a run of early-’80s hits, earning multiple chart successes and becoming a staple in iconic clubs like New York’s Paradise Garage. Their influence has endured far beyond the original fanbase—from being sampled by The Notorious B.I.G. in 1997 to appearing in Grand Theft Auto V in 2013. The Best Of The 12" Mixes, which compiles extended 12-inch versions and remixes by legendary producers Paul Hardcastle and François K, was first released on CD in 1992. Now, for the first time and exclusively for Record Store Day, Unidisc presents the collection as a double LP pressed on 180-gram heavyweight vinyl.

releases.title: The Song Society Playlist
releases.label: UMR/Island
releases.details:
The Song Society began in 2015 as a “window into Jamie Cullum’s own education” and song writing creation which follows four simple rules; 1. Find a song you love or are fascinated by. 2. Learn and record live within the hour. 3. No previous preparation allowed. 4. Love and live with the mistakes. 

Featuring jazz-style covers of chart-topping singles like Mark Ronson's 'Uptown Funk' and Ed Sheeran’s ‘Shape Of You’. With over 55M streams on DSPs, the much-loved project exclusively released on 140g red vinyl for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: What Dance Is This? UK Post-Punk Dancefloor 1979–1983 Vol. 1

They called it white funk once, but here you can even catch latin, dub and clubby influences, a mutant disco manifesto from a series of British magicians such as Medium Medium, Jah Wobble, Animal Magic, Blue Rondo A La Turk, Nightmare In Wax, Tappa Zukie and many more. Pressed on clear vinyl. Enjoy the wild party! THE DUM DUM' – Splat!; 'BALLAD OF THE DYING SIGH' - Dancing Did; 'GET IT RIGHT' – Animal Magic; 'BLACK LEATHER' – Nightmares In Wax; 'FREAK' – Tappa Zukie

releases.title: A Tribute to Pharoah Sanders
releases.label: ORG MUSIC
releases.details:
Recorded live at the Detroit Institute of Arts on July 20, 2025, A Tribute to Pharoah Sanders captures Detroit reed master Wendell Harrison and his ensemble TRIBE in a transcendent performance honoring Harrison’s longtime friend and fellow jazz icon. The concert—part of Detroit’s Concert of Colors festival and later broadcast on PBS—finds Harrison channeling Sanders’ spirit through deep tenor cries, hypnotic grooves, and Afro-spiritual improvisation.

Joined by an exceptional group of musicians including Sky Covington, Pamela Wise, Michael Abbo, Sam Melkonian, Kevin Dalton Jones, Allen Denard, Edward Gooche, Stephen Grady, Roberto Warren, and special guests, Harrison leads an inspired exploration of sound and soul. This limited LP will be released on vinyl exclusively for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: The Necessary Cosmic Frenzy
releases.label: Rhino
releases.details: The first ever solo Todd Rundgren performance captured live at Philadelphia’s legendary Sigma Sound Studios on June 30th, 1971 and broadcast live over WMMR. Featuring future Utopia keyboardist Mark “Moogy” Klingman, bassist Stu Woods, guitarist Tom Cosgrove and drummer Norman “N.D.” Smart.

releases.title: Walking On A Dream (Expanded Edition)
releases.label: UMG Australia
releases.details:
As the duo’s first full-length release, Walking On A Dream introduced the world to the Empire of the Sun universe and marked the beginning of their global ascent. 

The Expanded Edition (Record Store Day Exclusive) is a 2LP coloured 180g set with an obi-strip, featuring the full original album alongside six era-specific tracks, five of which appear on vinyl for the first time. The pressing uses a colour-in-colour sunrise effect, featuring opaque red and transparent yellow.

It brings the defining material from the WOAD era together in one package, marking it as a key catalogue moment and a standout title for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: Nilüfer Yanya Live at Metropolis
releases.label: Ninja Tune
releases.details:
Following the acclaim of her 2024 album My Method Actor, Nilüfer Yanya returns with an intimate, one-take Live-to-Vinyl session at Metropolis Studios.
The performance captures a raw snapshot of Yanya’s artistry, reworking standout moments from My Method Actor alongside fan favourites. The 12" includes “Method Actor,” “Call It Love,” “Binding,” and “The Dealer.”
My Method Actor earned praise from The Guardian, Pitchfork, The New York Times, Crack Magazine, and The Face. The Live-to-Vinyl release follows major touring, including a North American run with Alex G, UK dates supporting Lorde, and festival appearances at Glastonbury, Primavera, All Points East, Green Man, and Way Out West.
Nilüfer Yanya: 
“My band & I cherry picked 4 songs from the live show that we have been touring since the release of ‘My Method Actor’ that take on a life of their own on stage. Having the opportunity to record these at Metropolis archives the live show at a moment in time and hopefully makes for an enjoyable listening experience."

releases.title: 2 Meter Sessions
releases.label: Charly Records
releases.details: Never before released recordings - Amsterdam 1997 & 2000. For the first time ever on vinyl. Side A revisits the Sound of Lies era with “Trouble,” “Sound of Lies,” and “Big Star” in alternate acoustic versions, plus “Sister Cry,” extended from the 1992 Hollywood Town Hall era with loose, expressive instrumental interplay. Side B highlights the Smile era with “Somewhere in Ohio,” “Mr. Wilson,” “I’m Gonna Make You Love Me,” “What Led Me to This Town,” and “Smile.” These performances hum with warmth and space, capturing a band reconnecting with the heart of their songs. Each copy includes three signed postcards with a black-and-white session still and band members’ personal note, plus access to an archival video interview with Gary Louris and Marc Perlman. “If someone really gets our music, they feel it - it goes beyond the surface.” - The Jayhawks

releases.title: It Is So Easy
releases.label: Culture Factory (France).
releases.details: Buddy Holly remains one of the true architects of early rock & roll, blending irresistible melodies, innovative songwriting, and a sound that continues to influence generations. It Is So Easy brings together his most iconic recordings, including “That’ll Be the Day,” “Peggy Sue,” “Everyday,” “Rave On,” “True Love Ways,” and “Not Fade Away.” Fully remastered to highlight the clarity and brilliance of Holly’s original performances, this compilation celebrates the timeless spirit of a genuine pioneer. Pressed on Gold Vinyl and strictly limited to 1,000 copies, this edition also includes the CD, offering fans the ultimate way to rediscover Buddy Holly’s enduring magic.

releases.title: Diet Baby
releases.label: CMATBABY under exclusive licence to AWAL Recordings Ltd
releases.details: A repress of CMAT's lesser-spotted Diet Baby 12" - first released independently in 2021, it compiled her first four singles, and remains the only place you can own the criminally underrated masterpiece, Rodney! Rodney stans assemble!

releases.title: 18 Pieces For Orchestra
releases.label: Naxos
releases.details:
All tracks composed by Tony Banks (Genesis) and released for the first time on vinyl. Tony Banks was always fascinated by the idea of writing orchestral music. His success in composing for films led to the acclaimed 18 Pieces for Orchestra, which presents intense orchestral that rank among some of Banks’s most accomplished recordings. In these works, Banks combines experimentation with form and structure, and a trademark melodic character that powerfully conveys both melancholy and joy.

This 4-LP Boxset is housed in a luxury packaging with new artwork, fresh notes, and a signed insert from Tony Banks.

releases.title: Imagination
releases.label: Giant / Rhino
releases.details: Brian Wilson's 1998 solo album featuring remakes of 2 classic Beach Boys songs, and new compositions. First time on LP. 1-LP 140g black vinyl

releases.title: Julie Is A Junkie / Johnny And Dee Dee
releases.label: GROWN UP WRONG RECORDS
releases.details:
To commemorate the 40th Anniversary of the passing of James Darroch, singer/songwriter/guitarist for Sydney's incredible The Eastern Dark, Grown Up Wrong! is thrilled to announce a long-awaited reissue of the band's classic single "Julie Is A Junkie/Johnny and Dee Dee".

Heavily influenced by the Ramones - the band opened their first live show with 'Blitzkrieg Bop' and from then on opened with a new Ramones song every time they played, working through the band's complete catalogue in chronological order - as all manner of hyper-melodic and high energy rock. The Eastern Dark were a classic trio powered by former Celibate Rifles bassplayer James Darroch's blazing guitar and anchored by former Lime Spiders backing vocalist Bill Gibson's hard driving and melodic bass playing (and supreme backing vocals) and Geoff Milne's untouchable beat keeping. They set Sydney's Radio Birdman influenced scene alight in 1984 and quickly built an international following on the back of their classic single. Sadly, just hours after completing what would become their next release - the mini-LP "Long Live the New Flesh" - the band's life, and that of 26-year old James Darroch, was brutally ended in a road accident whilst the band was on its way to Melbourne.

On the back of the tragedy, the band's music lived on and it's global impact was reflected in the influence it bore on numerous bands, from Boston's the Lemoneads to Tokyo's Teengenenete, and obviously a succession of Australian bands from the Hard-Ons through to God and the Meanies and beyond. 

After years of searching, surviving members Bill Gibson and Geoff Milne recently found the single's original multi-track tapes, and for the new release, the original recordings have been both remixed and remastered for maximum impact under their supervision. The record will be available on YELLOW VINYL 

Listen to both sides here: THE EASTERN DARK - "Julie is a junkie" b/w "Johnny and Dee Dee" 7' single 1985

releases.title: Next Thing (10th Anniversary Edition)
releases.label: Bayonet Records
releases.details: Includes 3 demos of previously released tracks, including 2 that will be exclusive to this variant forever.

releases.title: Girl Like Me
releases.label: Warner Records
releases.details: Following the success of her critically acclaimed sophomore mixtape Fancy That and its star-studded remix expansion Fancy Some More?, PinkPantheress delivers an essential Record Store Day exclusive: the fan-favorite track "Girl Like Me." This limited RSD edition features the original track along with reimaginings by Kaytranada and Oklou. A masterclass in earworm production, "Girl Like Me" famously flips samples from Basement Jaxx’s “Romeo” into a jittery, UK garage-infused anthem. The track's continued cultural impact led to PinkPantheress gaining her first GRAMMY nominations in 2025, including Best Dance Pop Recording and a nod for Fancy That as Best Dance/Electronic Album. Released for RSD on a limited red vinyl 7".

releases.title: Can You Hear Me? The Remixes
releases.label: BMG
releases.details: Blue, red and yellow ecoformat inkplosion 12” vinyl featuring four never before heard remixes of single 'Can You Hear Me?'

releases.title: Odyssey: The Remix Collection (25th Anniversary Edition)
releases.label: Nettwerk
releases.details:
To celebrate 25 years since its original release, this definitive remix collection brings together Delerium’s most iconic trance reinterpretations from the 2000s — compiled together on vinyl for the very first time.

Featuring legendary remixes including DJ Tiësto’s landmark takes on “Silence” and “Innocente,” alongside contributions from Above & Beyond, Rabbit in the Moon, Matt Darey, and Airscape, this 2LP set captures the ethereal beauty and euphoric energy that defined an era.

Pressed on gold double vinyl and housed in a single sleeve with printed inner sleeves.

releases.title: Showcase
releases.label: Observer / Prestige Elite
releases.details: Freddie McGregor’s Showcase (1981), produced by roots reggae icon Winston “Niney” Holness, is a product of the era’s vocal-and-dub “showcase” format and a key release from one of Jamaica’s most iconic voices. Featuring dub-forward production and a seamless blend of Lovers Rock and conscious roots material, the album bridges the sound of 1970s Kingston with the more melodic direction that would carry McGregor into international success with ‘Big Ship’ the following year. This is the first official reissue in four decades and an essential record of McGregor’s early solo era. Limited edition numbered pressings on heavyweight color vinyl, exclusive for RSD26.

releases.title: Tell 'Em About It Johnny - Live At Winterland 1978
releases.label: Madfish
releases.details: Available for the first time on LP - The Winterland California show from 1978 in support of the band's '77 album 'Aliens'. 180g Crystal Clear vinyl - "a brilliant souvenir of a rare moment from our many wild adventures across America" - Jim Lockhart

releases.title: From The Other Side
releases.label: Madfish
releases.details: 4 Track 10” coloured vinyl featuring recently completed previously unreleased studio recordings. A tribute to the late singer Phil May & longstanding manager & producer Mark St John from founder member Dick Taylor.

releases.title: Live in Japan 1987 -FUKUI VOL.2-
releases.label: SOLID / TOYOKASEI
releases.details: A timeless treasure from the legendary trumpeter’s second visit to Japan will be released for RSD 2026 on deep-blue vinyl!! (Vol.2). On June 6, 1987, Chet Baker descended upon Phoenix Plaza in Fukui City, Japan! In this electrifying second volume of live recordings, the legendary trumpeter leads his favorite pianist Harold Danko and his trio in a fiercely swinging performance that captures Baker at the height of his late-career resurgence.

releases.artist: James Carter, Cyrus Chestnut, Ali Jackson, & Reginald Veal
releases.title: Gold Soundz: A Jazz Tribute To Pavement
releases.label: Modern Harmonic
releases.details: "This is fire-breathing music in the tradition of free jazz legends Pharaoh Sanders and Archie Shepp that sends the messy spirit of Pavement down roads the rockers could never have imagined." - Tom Moon (NPR) Celebrating the 20th anniversary of four jazz greats getting into the studio to add some swagger to slacker with this double LP of an enchanted rumble through Pavement cuts with a free jazz slant! This is the first ever LP release of the critically acclaimed CD from 2005, dramatically expanded with bonus material into a double LP. On coloured vinyl, featuring liners by Jim Allen, and art newly revised by Steve Keene!

releases.title: Extended Play – Volume I & Volume II
releases.label: Hiss And Shake Records
releases.details: Limited Neon (Barbie be Happy) Pink Vinyl for RSD 2026. LP is limited to 500 copies. Lora Logic was unexpectedly ousted from her first band X-Ray Spex before the recording of their debut studio album 'Germ Free Adolescents' in 1977. Undeterred, Lora went on to form and front the post-punk band Essential Logic. With trademark angular sax lines and her unmistakable vocal stylings, she went on to create some of the most liberating and exciting music of the early post-punk era, not only as Essential Logic, but also as a solo artist and as the go to sax moonlighter for other artists, including: the Stranglers, the Raincoats, Swell Maps and Red Crayola amongst others before her departure from the music industry in 1983. Lora would return from her musical hiatus in 1996 for the recording of the X-Ray Spex sophomore album ‘Conscious Consumer’ before taking a further leave of absence until 2021 when she returned to the studio to collaborate with fellow punk pioneers including Martin Muscatt, Dave Farren (Bad Manners) and Gary Valentine (Blondie) for the recording of what would become two new Essential Logic EP’s. Released in the dawn of a new technological era the recordings found a limited release via CD mailorder and early streaming sites before their inclusion on the 2003 Kill Rockstars compilation ‘Fanfare in the Garden’ CD release, solidifying the tracks significance as fan favourites amongst her earlier works. Essential Logic returned in 2022 with the new studio album ‘Land of Kali’ and remix album ‘Rekalibrated’ in 2024. This release presents both EP’s 1 & 2 in their entirety and original sequence, remastered and available for the first time as a standalone vinyl release on Neon ‘Barbie Be Happy’ Pink vinyl. Tracks: A1 On The Internet A2 Barbie Be Happy A3 No More Fiction A4 Not Me B1 Love Eternal B2 Under The Great City B3 Marika B4 The Beautiful And The Damned.

releases.title: Funkadelic
releases.label: ORG MUSIC
releases.details: Originally released in 1970, Funkadelic’s self-titled debut redefined the boundaries of funk, soul, and psychedelic rock. Remastered by Dave Gardner and reissued in August 2025 as part of Org Music’s ongoing Westbound Records series, this landmark album now returns as a limited-edition picture disc, available exclusively for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: Rascalize
releases.label: DeltaSonic Records
releases.details:
The Rascals are a British indie rock trio formed in 2006 by Miles Kane (guitar and vocals), Joe Edwards (bass) and Greg Mighall (drums), hailing from The Wirral on Merseyside. Before becoming The Rascals, all three members spent their formative years playing together in The Little Flames, gaining valuable experience touring with prominent contemporaries such as The Coral, The Zutons and, most significantly, Arctic Monkeys. It was while supporting Arctic Monkeys—drawing inspiration from their fiercely independent, DIY ethos and refusal to compromise—that the trio decided to trust their instincts and strike out on their own. 

Widely regarded as one of the strongest indie debuts of 2008, Rascalize cemented The Rascals’ place in the UK indie landscape. Now, with its first-ever vinyl release for Record Store Day 2026, the album offers both longtime fans and new listeners a chance to rediscover a bold, energetic record that captures a distinctive moment in British indie rock history.

releases.title: Bubblegum (Original Draft)
releases.label: Beggars Banquet
releases.details:
2LP (White Vinyl) - This limited-edition release of Mark Lanegan’s album Bubblegum marks the first time that his original plan for the record is being presented. During the sessions, Mark and his stellar cast of collaborators (PJ Harvey, Joshua Homme, Greg Dulli, & Duff McKagan etc) recorded enough material for two albums, but things changed and the album’s final track listing ended up being much different. This edition presents his original plan for the album. Pressed on white vinyl, this 2XLP has been beautifully mastered by Geoff Pesche at Abbey Road. Profits from the record will be donated to the newly created Mark Lanegan Foundation. 

Tracklisting: A1. When Your Number Isn't Up, A2. Hit the City (feat. PJ Harvey), A3. Mirrored, A4. Methamphetamine Blues, B1. One Hundred Days, B2. Bombed, B3. Like Little Willie John, B4. Strange Religion, C1. Josephine, C2. Come to Me (feat. PJ Harvey), C3. Message to Mine, C4. Wedding Dress, D1. Lexington Slow Down, D2. Skeletal History, D3. Blood (Crackers & Honey)

releases.title: Full Nelson
releases.label: Earache Records
releases.details:
Massive Wagons' fourth album ‘Full Nelson’ retained the charismatic, full-throttle rock‘n’roll that the band had become known for, laced together with a sharp eye and quick wit. They observed a darkening world and mined it for creative gold, taking shots at social media, bullies, bigots and conspiracy theorists along the way. 

Upon release, ‘Full Nelson’ shot to Number 16 in the UK Album Charts, following which the band got to tour Europe for the first time and also open for the likes of The Dead Daisies, The Wildhearts and Thunder. The stakes were raised even higher when they landed a coveted slot opening for Lynyrd Skynyrd and Status Quo. 

Since 'Full Nelson', Massive Wagons have released three further albums: two Top 10 albums in the form of 2020’s 'House Of Noise' and 2022’s 'Triggered!', and 2024’s Top 5 album 'Earth To Grace'. A band known as equally for their kindness as their riffs, the band became ambassadors for the charitable organisation Metal For Good earlier this year.

In celebration of this monumental era for the band, Record Store Day will feature ‘Full Nelson’ with new alternative blue artwork and two tracks that weren't originally featured: the chugging ‘Death Or Glory’ and the razor-sharp punk rager ‘Scorpion’. Pressed on White vinyl with Blue and Red splatter.

releases.title: Gull In The Wind
releases.label: Modern Sky UK
releases.details: The Lathums released their EP 'Gull In The Wind' on DSPs in Jan 2026. This is followed up by an exclusive physical release on Record Store Day of the EP. The Lathums released their third album 'Matter Does Not Define' in February 2025 and have since been on a sold out UK Tour plus Millenium Square in Leeds, UK Festival Run and played in Japan in October 2025.

releases.title: In Cold Blood
releases.label: VP / Greensleeves
releases.details: First repress since 1979 Red vinyl Originally released in 1978, In Cold Blood showcases the Keyboard King with a killer selection of riddims provided by the Aggrovators. In Cold Blood captures the Bunny Lee supreme team at the height of their revolutionary powers; all tracks feature Sly & Robbie, Tommy McCook, and Bobby Ellis superbly blending with Jackie Mittoo and Winston Wright’s mighty organ workouts. Mittoo’s contribution to reggae music is inestimable, both as a musician and arranger; he created innumerable bass lines, melodies and arrangements that have driven the music for decades. The album features the hits 'Sky Jack King’ and ‘Earthquake', a long-unavailable classic set produced by Bunny Lee and mixed by King Tubby. Newly remastered with liner notes and rare images.

releases.title: Live From The Camden Palace
releases.label: Culture Factory (France).
releases.details: GIRLSCHOOL is the longest running all-female rock band still active after more than 40 years. They maintain a worldwide cult following and are an inspiration for many female rock musicians. Original members Kim McAuliffe, Denise Dufort, and long-time member Jackie Chambers are still in the band. Live fron the Camden Palace was recorded in 1984 & is part of "The Live from London" series. It has never been released on vinyl before. This special deluxe 2 LP package includes: OBI side spine, original art work, printed inner sleeves and 1 Red/White cloud-effect LP & 1 Red/White splatter effect LP.

releases.title: New Song
releases.label: Geffen
releases.details: New Lucy Dacus Song

releases.title: Crying Laughing Loving Lying Expanded Edition
releases.label: Demon Records
releases.details:
Expanded into a Double Vinyl LP for the first time, this classic and timeless album now features 8 bonus tracks on vinyl in addition to the original album with bonus tracks including the hit single ‘Watch Me’. Pressed on a stunning Yellow 2LP exclusively for Record Store Day.
Now not just an admired iconic and influential artist and writer of incredible timeless classic songs, Labi Siffre in 2025 became a TikTok sensation and as part of a wider catalogue reappraisal and promotion his breakthrough album from 1972 ‘Crying Laughing Loving Lying’ is reissued as the beginning of this new campaign
The album features the beautiful original version of “It Must Be Love”, a # 14 hit for Labi nine years before Madness took it to the top, the album title track as featured in the 2023 cult film ‘The Holdovers’, ‘Cannock Chase’ and “My Song”, as sampled by Kanye West for “I Wonder”.
Labi’s profile has exploded in the US and beyond as the streaming, TikTok and Insta generation have responded in their millions to his music and with artists as diverse as Miley Cyrus, Greta Van Fleet, Lady Blackbird, Celeste, The Courteeners and Whitney all covering and performing Labi Siffre songs, his influence continues to build and he continues to be discovered by waves of new generations every year

releases.title: Mission Impossible 30th Anniversary Edition
releases.label: Decca Classics
releases.details:
This Record Store Day 2026 red coloured vinyl 2LP release marks the 30th anniversary of Danny Elfman's score to the 1996 blockbuster movie Mission: Impossible.

It includes the instantly recognisable Mission: Impossible theme, originally composed by Lalo Schifrin for the 1960s TV series, and rearranged by Elfman for the first movie in the Tom Cruise action franchise. The theme is known for its suspense-filled rhythm with an unusual 5/4 time signature, and the famous four-note motif that opens the piece: a musical nod to the Morse Code pattern for the letters M.I. (‐‐ ··). This clever encoding not only ties the theme directly to the title but also reinforces the atmosphere of secret communications, covert operations, and puzzles that define the world of Mission: Impossible.

releases.title: Live in London 1980
releases.label: Demon Records
releases.details: First ever release for this incredible live concert from Ian Dury & The Blockheads at London’s Dominion Theatre on Christmas Eve 1980, pressed exclusively for Record Store Day on Orange coloured 2LP. Originally transmitted as a special TV performance for the ‘Old Grey Whistle Test’ on BBC2 TV and for John Peel on BBC Radio 1. Following on from the run of singles "Reasons to Be Cheerful, Part 3", "I Want to Be Straight" and "Sueperman's Big Sister" 1980 saw the release of new album ‘Laughter’ by Ian Dury & The Blockheads. The ‘Laughter’ tour took place in December 1980 and on Christmas Eve Ian Dury & The Blockheads performed at London’s Dominion Theatre live on Radio 1 and on TV via BBC2’s ‘Old Grey Whistle Test’ – introduced on TV by Annie Nightingale and on radio by John Peel. With The Blockheads now featuring former Dr Feelgood frontman, Wilko Johnson on guitar taking the place of the now departed Chaz Jankel the live show also features additional musicians Don Cherry (father of Neneh) and Topper Headon (The Clash) in addition to the Blockheads line up of lan Dury, Davey Payne, John Turnbull, Norman Watt-Roy, Mickey Gallagher and Charlie Charles.

releases.title: The Solo albums
releases.label: Rhino / Elektra
releases.details: The landmark debut solo albums from David Crosby, Stephen Stills and Graham Nash after the overwhelming success of the Crosby, Stills & Nash and Deja Vu. The set also includes an LP of rarities from demos and sessions for all three albums.

releases.title: Basic Blaze
releases.label: Slip-N-Slide
releases.details: Seminal New Jersey producers, Blaze are recognised as one of the greatest production outfits in House Music. Formed in 1984 and with over 100 releases to their name, undoubtedly one of the highlights of their rich and expansive discography is their 1997 LP, Basic Blaze. Containing some of their best work to date across eight tracks, it’s an essential listen for any house music fan. With the only copies available selling on the second market for £60+, now for the first time since the initial release, Defected & Slip N Slide present an exclusive reissue for RSD. Pressed on transparent yellow vinyl, housed in a replica artwork sleeve this is a much-needed reissue for all House Music fans!

releases.title: No Dice

releases.details:
Second studio album by British rock band Badfinger issued by Apple Records. No Dice significantly increased the band’s popularity internationally, including peaking at #28 in the Hot 200 Billboard chart, and single ‘No Matter What’ reached #8 in the Hot 100 Billboard Singles Chart. ‘Without You’ went on to be one of the world’s best-known songs as it was covered by the likes of Harry Nilsson and Mariah Carey. 

This is the first time the 2010 remasters have been pressed on vinyl.

releases.title: Soho Scene '63 Vol 2: Jazz Goes Mod
releases.label: 1960s Records
releases.details:
Compare the best of British jazz circa 1963 with American sounds from labels such as Prestige, Tangerine and World Pacific. This album captures the period when rhythm and blues is emerging as the dominant club sound, forcing Soho jazz clubs to change their music policy in order to survive. On the British side, you’ve got Ronnie Scott’s arrangement of Last Minute Bossa Nova; Bang!, taken from Dick Morrissey Quartet’s first session for the BBC’s World Service, recorded around the time of the release of their first album Have You Heard? The version here is take two. You can hear take one along with the rest of the eleven-track session on R&B18 Jazz For Moderns. 
Early In The Morning is a Ginger Baker/Jack Bruce arrangement of the traditional work song realized as a repeated blues riff, and is the first ever recording that is recognizably British Blues. Graham Bond features on alto sax along with Bruce and Baker together as members of the Johnny Burch Octet heard playing live at a BBC staff party from March 1963. Side Two features Jazz Stateside, such as West Coast guitarist Johnny Hartsman, Gene Ammons veering into proto jazz-funk on Jungle Soul, aka Ca' Purange plus a couple of top notch Hammond workouts from Terrell Prude and Charles Kynard.
