releases.title: Computers and Blues
releases.label: Locked On
releases.details:
Computers and Blues is the fifth studio album by pioneering British rap artist, The Streets. 

The album, which includes the single 'Going Through Hell' and features guest performances by Robert Harvey (The Music), Laura Vane and Clare Maguire, is available on vinyl for the first time ever this Record Store Day in partnership with War Child. 

Pressed on Yellow vinyl. Limited to 2,000 copies.

releases.title: Vibes Alive
releases.label: R.A.S Records
releases.details:
Originally released in 1992 and never reissued on vinyl since then, « Vibes Alive » captures the essence of Israël Vibration.

The ORIGINAL ROOTS RADICS backing band is composed of Errol Flabba Holt on bass, Style Scott on drums, Bingy Bunny on rhythm guitar, Dwight Pinckney on lead guitar, and Tee Birdd on keyboards.

Recorded live at the Catalyst, Santa Cruz, California, Oct . 2. 1991 and produced by Doctor Dread, Apple, Wiss and Skelly deliver all the strength, the sincerity and the power of « the trinity » in their fabulous vocal harmonies. This record only includes songs which became classics and is considered by all reggae specialists and fans as the best live album released by the band.

releases.title: Extra Texture
releases.label: Dark Horse Records
releases.details: Continuation of the RSD exclusive series reissuing George Harrison's full studio album catalog on limited, numbered Zoetrope vinyl. In late 1974, George returned to California to record his next album, the soul-tinged Extra Texture (Read All About It.) Leon Russell played piano on “Tired of Midnight Blue, ” and for some of the sessions, Harrison was joined by guitarist Jesse Ed Davis, plus Jim Keltner, Paul Stallworth, and David Foster from new band Attitudes, who were later signed by George’s newly formed Dark Horse label.

releases.title: The Lost Tapes Vol.7
releases.label: BMG
releases.details:
Now onto the seventh volume of the cherished The Löst Tapes series, join us for Lemmy’s 50th birthday at the famous Whisky a Go Go, West Hollywood in December 1995. 

Following a series of tour dates across Europe and a short trip to South America, the now three-piece celebrated Lem’s birthday in style with a fearless, celebratory bash that now only saw the band rip through the classics but also a surprise support slot from non-other than Metallica, who took the stage as ‘The Lemmys’.

releases.title: When Your Garden's Overgrown (Live at the BBC / Boy About Town (Live At The BBC)
releases.label: Parlophone
releases.details:
Paul Weller celebrates Record Store Day this year with the release of a special 7” vinyl single featuring two songs recorded live in session for the BBC.
When Your Garden’s Overgrown was recorded at the BBC Radio Theatre on 14/5/2015, for Jo Whiley / BBC Radio 2’s In Concert. 
Boy About Town was recorded at the BBC Radio Theatre, on 3/2/2019 for Jo Whiley / BBC Radio 2’s In Concert. Featuring The London Metropolitan Orchestra and Hannah Peel.

releases.title: Self Titled (Acoustic)
releases.label: Island
releases.details: Mercury prize and BRIT nominated Kae Tempest re-imagines his fifth studio album Self Titled, once again teaming up with critically acclaimed producer Fraser T Smith. Pressed on exclusive transparent crystal black vinyl, the record features new, stripped back versions of every track from the album.

releases.title: The New World Order
releases.label: Legacy Rep
releases.details: x2 Translucent Green Coloured LP Vinyl - 30th anniversary pressing - and the very first time on coloured vinyl - for an underground classic that hasn't been issued anywhere since 1996 and has become rare and highly coveted. Widely regarded as the New Jersey's crew's best album, it features guest spots from The Fugees and KRS One.

releases.title: Swamp Dogg Gets His Pool Painted
releases.label: Joyful Noise Recordings
releases.details: Official, first-time release of soundtrack for film Swamp Dogg Gets His Pool Painted

releases.title: Saturday Teenage Kick
releases.label: Real Gone Music
releases.details: (Limited, Expanded 2-LP Sea Blue Vinyl Edition) By the time he reached 30, young Tom Holkenborg had already produced and played with the Dutch new wave band Weekend at Waikiki, formed an industrial rock group (Nerve) that recorded two albums, produced bands like Sepultura and Fear Factory, and licensed his own electronic synth creations for video games. But all of that was mere prelude for what was about to unfold; for in 1997, Holkenborg adopted his Junkie XL persona and embarked on a journey that was to wind up with his composing wildly acclaimed film scores for films like Mad Max: Fury Road, 300: Rise of an Empire, Divergent, and Deadpool. But it all got started with this album, Saturday Teenage Kick, the first project released under the Junkie XL moniker and to this day a groundbreaking blend of rock and electronica. Never before released on vinyl outside of his native Netherlands, and featuring the album-closing track “Future in Computer Hell”/”Mulu” that has never appeared on vinyl, it appears here in a double sea blue pressing limited to 1500 copies, exclusive for Record Store Day.

releases.title: Remixes
releases.label: Ministry
releases.details: Light Blue 12" Vinyl single - Available for the first time on vinyl, this release brings together on Light Blue vinyl all three remixes of KH - Looking At Your Pager from Solomun, Chris Lake and Clipz plus a brand new remix from MPH of KH & Nelly Furtado - Only Human.

releases.title: Extra-Capsular Extraction
releases.label: Fire Records
releases.details: 1000 copies on Transparent Yellow vinyl. Earth, the pioneering project of Dylan Carlson, laid the groundwork for drone metal with their very first release, 1991’s Extra-Capsular Extraction - a three-track EP that features Kurt Cobain on “A Bureaucratic Desire for Revenge, Part 2.” A cornerstone of heavy minimalism and sludge, this debut marks the arrival of the genre’s original pre-drone gods. Reissued for the first time in 20 years and pressed on colour vinyl. “The fountainheads of drone metal” Pitchfork.

releases.title: Quarrelsome Moments: B-Sides and Rarities
releases.label: Commercial Group
releases.details: x1 Black LP Vinyl - Curated by Ian Broudie, this collection of b-sides and rarities from across the band's career includes alternate mixes, cover versions and two previously unreleased tracks.

releases.title: The Re-Mixes
releases.label: Chrysalis Records
releases.details: Taken from the recent deluxe edition of Ultravox's The Collection compilation. These 10 newly created 12" Extended Re-Mixes make their debut on white vinyl, featuring mixes by Midge Ure, Steven Wilson, Blank & Jones and more. Tracks include All Stood Still, Hymn, The Thiun Wall and more.

releases.title: In A Perfect World (expanded)
releases.label: Commercial Group
releases.details: x2 Black LP Vinyl - Expanded 2LP pressing featuring 2nd disc; many tracks new to vinyl. Includes art card.

releases.title: Boston Music Hall, Boston, MA 6/11/76
releases.label: RBDO
releases.details: This 5LP, 180-gram vinyl set is the second installment of a five-part series of breakouts from the sold-out, limited-edition June 1976 CD Boxed Set originally released in 2020. Newly remastered for vinyl by Jeffrey Norman, featuring Plangent Processes tape restoration and speed correction. Produced for release by Grateful Dead archivist and legacy manager, David Lemieux. Limited Edition of 7,600. The fifth show of the Grateful Dead's comeback tour in June 1976 finds the band firing on all cylinders as they settle back into life on the road. A setlist filled with older material (Candyman, Eyes Of The World, Tennessee Jed), new material (Might As Well, Lazy Lightning, Supplication, Samson and Delilah), and new arrangements of classics from the Dead's early days (St. Stephen, Dancing In The Street), this new iteration of the Grateful Dead featuring the return of Mickey Hart is one of the most powerful and precise versions of the band to date. With the Wall Of Sound retired, the Dead were playing the intimate confines of small theatres for the first time in years, and the perfection they achieved on this tour is on full display on June 11, 1976, in Boston. The magnificence of the vocal arrangements is one of the many new sonic highlights of the 1976 Grateful Dead, many Dead Heads saying the vocal harmonies never sounded as great as they did in June 1976. Songs like Looks Like Rain and The Music Never Stopped show off this renewed focus on the spectacular vocals the Dead were able to achieve. - David Lemieux

releases.title: Here Come The Tears
releases.label: UMR/Concord
releases.details: First vinyl reissue of The Tears' debut album, originally released on Independiente in 2005. The album marked the first reunion of Suede's Brett Anderson and Bernard Butler and included singles "Refugees," "Lovers" and "Autograph." Pressed on colored vinyl.

releases.title: French Dogs EP
releases.label: Ciao Ketchup Recordings
releases.details:
Following their explosive arrival on the scene last year, London’s indie rockers French Dogs make their highly
anticipated debut on wax for Record Store Day 2026. 
This RSD Exclusive 12-inch vinyl edition is strictly limited to a small run of 500 units, with each sleeve individually hand-numbered on the back.
The EP is a four-track snapshot of late nights and restless hearts, capturing the unfiltered energy
that has already ignited the UK indie scene. 
Critics have hailed the band as “one of the most exciting names heating up the UK underground” (The Songbird HQ)
- “I love ‘Treasure’ from French Dogs.” - Jess Iszatt, BBC Introducing (Radio 1 / BBC London)
- "A rollercoaster of tracks that feels strikingly alive" (Good Music Radar)
- “Loud, and real... a debut that leaves you ready to shout along” (Illustrate Magazine).
Proving that “great riffs never go out of fashion” (The Big Takeover), French Dogs provide a “crisp but
not clean” collection that “turns poor decisions into pure momentum” (Mystic Sons).

releases.title: Live At Pascoe Vale HIgh School 1977
releases.label: GROWN UP WRONG
releases.details:
- Previously unheard live recording from '77 of legendary Aussie power pop pioneers Beathoven, who were described by Kim Fowley as 'the Tasmanian Bay City Rollers'. - Huge in their home state, Beathoven failed to break nationally (despite multiple TV appearances and a Best New Band' nomination at the 1978 Countdown Awards) and eventually morphed into the Innocents, who are also much loved in power pop circles.
- Both Beathoven and the Innocents have been recently names as favourites by THE LEMON TWIGS! 
- Recorded live to two track, this album captures the mania surrounding the band and captures the band at their early Beatles best and sounds like The Beatles at the Hollywood Bowl reenacted in a Melbourne highschool in the '70s! Includes great versions of fan faves like "Please Don't Go", "Darlin'" and "Shy Girl" and plenty of songs never before released.
- Blue vinyl and liner notes by the band's David Minchin, with plenty of cool pix and memorabilia.
- Essential for international fans of '70s power pop and classic Australian rock.

releases.title: Blue Lake
releases.label: Charly Records
releases.details: The spirit of Don Cherry soars again. For Record Store Day 2026, Charly Records and BYG Records present the first-ever official reissue of Blue Lake, Cherry’s transcendent live set originally released in 1974 only in Japan and long out of print. Fully restored and remastered from the original master tapes, this deluxe 2LP gatefold edition brings back to life one of the rarest treasures in the avant-jazz canon — a record that has fetched hundreds of dollars on the collector market for decades. Following the success of last year’s Record Store Day release of 'Orient' — which captured music from the same 1971 concert — this long-awaited companion volume completes the picture of Cherry’s pan-global vision: a sound that dissolves borders and dances between jazz, folk, and world ritual. Recorded live in Paris on April 22, 1971, the performance captures Cherry at his creative zenith, alongside South African bassist Johnny Dyani and Turkish percussionist Okay Temiz. The trio moves like a living organism — fluid, spontaneous, and deeply spiritual. The opening piece, Blue Lake, finds Cherry on flute, channeling Native American inflections that blend seamlessly with Far-Eastern tonalities. The following two extended compositions — each stretching past the twenty-five-minute mark — are sprawling journeys of rhythm and resonance, rich with cross-cultural dialogue and ecstatic improvisation. This deluxe reissue comes housed in a beautiful gatefold sleeve and features new, in-depth liner notes by acclaimed jazz writer Kevin Le Gendre, offering fresh insight into Cherry’s universal musical philosophy. A lost masterpiece, reborn for Record Store Day 2026 — Don Cherry’s Blue Lake: the sound of freedom without frontiers.

releases.title: And Yeah So (1981​-​1985)
releases.label: LANTERN REC.
releases.details: The first ever compilation by Splat! Emerging amid the primo froth of the British post-punk era. Splat! were four, sometimes five, misfits from a small town halfway between Nottingham and Derby in the middle of England. Influenced by the likes of the Pop Group, PiL, The Fall and the Birthday Party.

releases.title: Some Candy Talking (40th Anniversary)
releases.label: Warner Music UK

releases.title: Untitled (Albini Rough Mixes)
releases.label: Touch and Go Records
releases.details: "Despite Steve Albini relentlessly advocating for Touch and Go Records to release Tweez in 1989, we declined. A few weeks later, Steve invited Slint to an impromptu recording session to make use of some studio time booked by another band who did not show up. At the end of the session, Steve did a quick mix for the band to take home. The next day, Steve dropped off a tape of those mixes to me at the Touch and Go office. These new Slint recordings blew my mind and I could not stop listening to them. Shortly thereafter, we agreed to release Slint's next album on Touch and Go – the soon to be recorded Spiderland." - Corey Rusk, Touch and Go Records

releases.title: Live At Metropolis
releases.label: Brownswood
releases.details:
Following the success of their 2025 album Tuff Times Never Last and a headline show at O2 Academy Brixton, Kokoroko return with a raw, one-take session at Metropolis Studios. 

The London-based afrobeat jazz septet delivers their signature grooves and wide-ranging influences—from 80s Brit-funk and R&B to West African disco—captured live straight to vinyl in their Jack Daniel’s Revive Live session. 

This four-track EP features ‘Higher’ from Get The Message, highlights from their second album, and a never-before-released cover of ‘Express Your Love’, offering a raw, one-take glimpse into the band’s evolving artistry. 

Kokoroko: 
“Cutting live-to-vinyl is kind of like stamping time, you’re capturing this moment that’s not going to happen the same way again. We love vinyl, so it just felt right; doing it in the spirit of some of our favourite records. We’d never played some of these songs like this before, it felt like the perfect way to capture them. We also covered Sweet and Innocent’s ‘Express Your Love’ (such a gorgeous track) and it’s the first time recording Noushy on lead vocals with us. She sounds amazing, and we really wanted to give her that shine.”

releases.title: Moon Safari - Live Theatre Herodes Atticus, Athènes
releases.label: Warner Music France
releases.details:
Recorded during a warm night in Athens under the Acropolis, this album captures Air at their most magnetic and ethereal. Blending analog warmth with their unmistakable electronic grace, the duo plays its classic album unveils new arrangements that resonate through the oldest theater in the world's mesmerizing acoustics.

Each track becomes a dialogue between the French duo’s timeless sound and the Athenian stones — intimate, shimmering, and full of emotion. “The Athens Concert” is not just a concert recording; it’s a sonic memory of a unique night that united music, light, and history in perfect harmony. And the first live album ever released by the legendary French band to celebrate their 2024 - 2025 tour.

releases.title: Roasted Right: Expanded Edition
releases.label: Modern Harmonic
releases.details: Direct from the recently recovered reels it's the SNZ 1994 EP getting it's first ever reissue and bringing bonus tracks along with it. Newly mixed from the original multitracks and includes unheard original session material combined with a B side full of rehearsal sessions of SNZ favorites from their reunion with Katharine Whalen for their NC Music Hall of Fame induction in 2020. It features liner notes penned by Katharine. Clocking in at a bit over 22 minutes it's as about as expanded as an EP can get before becoming an LP!

releases.title: Remix The Chaos (Volume One)
releases.label: 100% Records
releases.details:
Morcheeba unveil Remix The Chaos: Volume 1, the first instalment in a three-part remix series drawn from their 11th studio album, Escape The Chaos (2025). 

Spanning four tracks per volume, the project brings together an eclectic, global roster of electronic producers, each offering a distinct reimagining of Morcheeba’s unmistakable sound. Multi-genre and far-reaching, the series expands further into the rich sonic world the band have built over the past few decades, pushing their music into bold, contemporary electronic territory. Volume 1 features remixes from Paula Tape, the Chilean superstar producer, recent Mixmag cover star and one of electronic music’s most exciting names heading into 2026; Trance Wax (a.k.a. Ejeca), the prolific Belfast producer specialising in high-energy breakbeat and trance-leaning remixes; Frazer Ray, the London-based underground force known for UK bass, breaks and garage; and Brothers Counsell, a side project from the formidable Joy Anonymous. 

Together, the tracks form a journey of dancefloor-ready hard hitters, powered by Morcheeba’s iconic vocals and signature guitar lines. Pressed on limited edition traffic light red vinyl, Remix The Chaos: Volume 1 comes with deep-cut grooves designed to hit just as hard on a club sound system as they do from the comfort of your living room.

releases.title: Changin' Times
releases.label: Rhino
releases.details: 2026 marks the 50th anniversary of Ike White’s only full-length studio release, 'Changin’ Times.' To celebrate, it's getting a much-overdue refresh with a brand new RSD Exclusive 1LP vinyl featuring tracks cut from the original analog tape and brand new liner notes. Music producer Jerry Goldstein originally recorded the album from within the walls of Folsom State Prison where Ike was serving a life sentence, and where the musical prodigy spent his time writing and performing alongside fellow inmates. His advocates and fans include the likes of Stevie Wonder and Snoop Dogg and, with the release of a 2020 doc, there is renewed interest in Ike's music and legacy.

Recorded with Grammy Award winner Jim Lowe (Stereophonics, Nick Cave, Taylor Swift), The K's second studio album 'Pretty On The Internet' followed the breakout success of their debut LP, 'I Wonder If The World Knows?' which reached #3 in the UK Official Albums chart.
Released in July 2025, the album anchored a rigorous live schedule which saw the band take their much lauded live show across Europe and to countless festival main stages. 2026 will see the band continue to reach new heights, including their largest headline show to date at Castlefield Bowl (8,000) in July, which sold out 7 months in advance."

releases.title: The Bunkhouse Vol. 1: Anchor Black Tattoo
releases.label: Fionn Regan Music
releases.details:
Fionn Regan’s fourth album The Bunkhouse Vol. 1: Anchor Black Tattoo, originally released in 2012, now available on vinyl for the first time for Record Store Day 2026.

Written and recorded using just an acoustic guitar, a single microphone, and a 4-track, The Bunkhouse Vol. 1 shows Regan at his most minimal. A raw and stripped back collection of songs, recorded quickly, with brevity and focus at their core. Regan sees himself as “a visual artist as much as a songwriter”, and this album perfectly illustrates the meeting of the two. Each song serves as a chapter, an image rendered with shrewd simplicity, brooding humour and the salt of the Irish Sea. 

The Bunkhouse Vol. 1: Anchor Black Tattoo shows Fionn Regan at his most sparse, and it’s clear to see how it has become a favourite among his fans. It has also been widely praised across the press, receiving glowing reviews from the likes of The Guardian, The Sunday Times, Mojo and Uncut.

releases.title: The Tension Between
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details:
After a triumphant return with 'Pillars' — The Sun (4★), Classic Pop (4★), and Rolling Stone UK “Album of the Week” — Jack Garratt presents The Tension Between: a brand new collection of songs written and recorded in the months following 'Pillars', and released for the first time exclusively on vinyl and CD for Record Store Day.

Across 9 brand new tracks, this release captures Garratt at his most fluid and instinctive. The result feels like the bridge between past and future, and a deeper insight into the recording sessions that brought him back after nearly quitting.

This release celebrates Jack’s creative resurgence. 
For collectors, this represents a never-before-heard chapter from one of the UK’s most innovative writer-producers — a limited release that won’t be available digitally until later in 2026.

releases.title: Coming Up at the BBC
releases.label: Demon Records
releases.details:
The landmark 1996 album reconstructed from BBC sessions and live recordings! Suede’s commercial high watermark came in 1996 with ‘Coming Up’. The 1995 addition to the line-up of lead guitarist Richard Oakes and keyboard player Neil Codling had given the band a new impetus and focus. At the very pinnacle of ‘Britpop’ – a scene they’d helped inspire but fiercely operated outside of – roared back with an adrenalin rush of new Suede classics. 

The first missive from ‘Coming Up’ was the trailblazing ‘Trash’, which reached No. 3 in the UK chart – a joint career-best for the band. That was followed into the Top 10 over the next twelve months by four more hit singles from the album - ‘Beautiful Ones’, ‘Lazy’, ‘Saturday Night’, and ‘Filmstar’. 

During ‘Coming Up’s' album and singles lifespan of more than a year the band toured almost constantly – taking in the USA, Japan, Europe and right across the UK. The culmination of a year’s precision-tooling of the material in the live arena came 22nd August 1997 and a triumphant headlining slot at Reading Festival. 

Collected here are selected recordings from the Reading gig, broadcast on BBC Radio 1, plus some previously unreleased studio takes of the album’s tracks recorded for the station’s Evening Session and Mark Radcliffe shows. Cherrypicked by the band as the best possible ‘Coming Up’ BBC recordings, they’ve been sequenced for ‘Coming Up At The BBC’ in the same order as the original studio album. 

Note: Because no contemporary or BBC versions of the album’s penultimate song, ‘The Chemistry Between Us’ exists, Suede have kindly donated a previously unreleased 1999 live version recorded by the same line up at that year’s Roskilde Festival.

releases.title: Love Is A Wish Away
releases.label: Creation Youth
releases.details: The emergence of Felice Rosser’s FaithNYC reveals another facet of the seemingly infinite diamond of Black American music. Born in Detroit, she experienced Motown, the 1967 riots, Funkadelic, The MC5, The Stooges and The New York Dolls before moving to New York City for college. Blown away by Television at CBGB’s, she became part of the scene, befriending Samo— Jean Michel Basquiat’s tag at that time—and starting to write songs and play bass. Inspired by punk’s DIY attitude, Rock & Roll, Funk, Free Jazz, Dub, Reggae and the new Hip Hop scene all became part of her musical language. The title track has been streamed nearly 400,000 times. This is the first ever vinyl pressing. LP & 12" of Youth Remixes. Coloured Vinyl

releases.title: Our Lives
releases.label: Violent Drum Recordings
releases.details:
Encompassing celebrated artists such as George Clinton, Lee ‘Scratch’ Perry, Alfred Pee Wee Ellis and many more, star-studded funk collective, Smudge All Stars will release their remix EP ‘Our Lives’ via Violent Drum Recordings on April 18, 2026.

With renowned session musician Richie Stevens at the helm, Smudge All Stars is a sprawling intelligence network reflecting London’s cultural melting pot – it’s ever-revolving door policy deep-rooted by some of music’s most esteemed innovators. The group’s debut single, ‘Our Lives’ marries funk and reggae’s vintage relationship and is a ray of sunshine reminding all to get the most out of life, even in these increasingly testing times.

releases.title: The Great Western Road Trip. A Live Album
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details:
On March 30th we gave the first performance of The Great Western Road Trip at Edinburgh’s Usher Hall.

As if opening night anxiety was not enough, we were also playing nine new songs for the very first time with the added fear factor of a request by BBC Scotland to record the concert. Somehow all of these factors combined to focus us into playing, what we now realise, was one of our best performances there or anywhere for some time.

There was one unknown factor. That night was to be the last time we would play in Scotland with our friend and brother James Miller Prime. So, this is a very special recording of six close friends and musicians making music, unaware they were on their last ever run of shows together. We hope the excitement we felt at creating the show comes over and you enjoy this unique recording of very special Edinburgh night.

Dedicated to James Miller Prime
(3 November 1960 – 19 June 2025)

Includes 25 career spanning greatest hits and nine tracks from 2025's Top 3 album The Great Western Road.

This blue smoke triple vinyl set is housed in a trifold sleeve with poster.

1000 copies only, each one Individually numbered.

The show features Michael Des Barres on vocals after Robert Palmer departed, with the original lineup of Tony Thompson, Andy Taylor and John Taylor. Spanning over 90 minutes, including an incredible 17 minute performance of Obsession - co-written by Michael Des Barres, classics from the debut album and other covers such as The Reflex, Hungry Like The Wolf and White Light White Heat - Power Mad is a fabulous documentation of one of the best and biggest supergroups in music history.

releases.title: Brightside
releases.label: V2 Records
releases.details:
With Brightside, Ziggy Marley delivers an album rooted in intention, sound and deep musical connection.

Released exclusively on vinyl (Orange vinyl) and CD for Record Store Day on April 18, 2026, this album will only arrive on streaming services at a later date. This makes Record Store Day the first and only place to experience Brightside in its purest form, before it is available anywhere else.

Designed with a physical-first philosophy, Brightside is meant to be heard as a complete audio experience. Ziggy recorded the album in 432Hz, a frequency often associated with meditation, balance and healing. To fully capture this specific sonic vision, his studio was rebuilt at the new Tuff Gong campus, allowing for warm, organic and earth-grounded tones.

Recorded with a live band, the songs on Brightside took on a life of their own during the sessions. The performances are expansive, immersive and deeply musical, emphasizing feel and atmosphere over convention. The result is an album that invites listeners to slow down, listen closely and connect with the music on a deeper level.

At its core, Brightside carries a message of healing, reflection and perspective. It is an album built around sound quality, intention and emotion, created to be experienced fully on vinyl or CD.

releases.title: Leisure Noise
releases.label: London Records
releases.details:
Riding a wave of intense media attention and industry hype, Gay Dad became the first band ever to appear on Top of the Pops before releasing a record. Their debut album, Leisure Noise, arrived in 1999, entering the UK charts at No. 14. Described as “thrillingly energising, gorgeously melodic and strangely beautiful,” the album produced several charting singles: the top 10 hit 'To Earth With Love,' followed by 'Joy!' and 'Oh Jim.'
Featuring production from Gary Langan (Art of Noise), Chris Hughes (Tears for Fears, Peter Gabriel, Paul McCartney, Propaganda), and Tony Visconti (on 'To Earth With Love'), Leisure Noise was well received by the media, though in some circles it struggled to meet the lofty expectations surrounding the band. Nevertheless, it has endured as a cult favourite. Now reissued on vinyl for the first time since 1999, Leisure Noise returns on coloured vinyl with a die-cut sleeve.

releases.title: Sex: Craft Must Have Clothes
releases.label: Stranger Than Paradise Records
releases.details:
Exclusively for Record Store Day 2026

Stranger Than Paradise Records presents the third and final installment of gems and nuggets from the infamous jukebox at Malcolm McLaren and Vivienne Westwood’s King’s Road SEX boutique from 1974 to 1976.

These influential jukebox tracks paved the way for a new genre called ‘Punk’ and proved formative to all those who frequented SEX at an early age—The Sex Pistols, Chrissie Hynde, Adam Ant, Siouxsie Sioux, among just a few.

The remix has quickly gained momentum, earning support from leading DJs including Peggy Gou, Chris Stussy, and Jamie Jones, and introducing the original track to a new generation of listeners. To mark its resurgence, the record has been reissued on limited edition 180g Orange Crush Vinyl, offering fans and collectors a vibrant new edition of this dance-floor staple.

releases.title: Pioneers

releases.details:
Today's visionary female and gender expansive electronic artists create new tracks inspired by pioneering heroines of the past. 

Pioneers celebrates the little-known lineage of female composers who were fundamental to the invention and evolution of electronic music. Against the backdrop of the turbulent socio-political landscape of the 20th century, they fearlessly experimented with machines and early technologies, unlocking processes and techniques that continue to shape how we produce, record and listen to music today.

Pioneers includes tracks by Arushi Jain, Loraine James, Kaitlyn Aurelia Smith, rRoxymore, Leila Adu, Holland Andrews, yuniya edi kwon, TAAHLIAH, Hinako Omori, Kate Simko, Lara Somogyi, Jlin, Laurel Halo and Afrodeutsche

releases.title: Loguerhythms: Songs From The Establishment
releases.label: Poppydisc
releases.details: White Colour vinyl. After her start as the wee Scottish girl in The Little Rascals movies, on to a mistress of bop vocalese with Lambert, Hendricks and Ross, dropping out of the mainstream as Lenny Bruce's girlfriend/drug buddy, she returned to the UK....Soho in the 1960s called to her, the world of Ronnie Scott Brit Bop, of Georgie Fame allnighters, and Peter Cook's Satirical Nightclub, The Establishment, home of the satire boom, beatniks and of course jazz....where she played with BritBop drum-master and early Rock and Roll band leader Tony Kinsey, performing songs by Private Eye affiliated poet Christopher Logue....can't get more of a snapshot of a time than that....unless I am in it as a child (I lived nearby then)....or young Una Stubbs dances out of a poster to kiss Tony Newley....Annie Ross, Scotland's queen of Jazz, take a bow, on RevOla/PoppyDisc vinyl....a classic album in original look and sound yet brand new.....relive a legend with the wonderful voice of Annie Ross....

releases.title: Animal Pleasure + Tall In The Saddle & More
releases.label: Jungle Records
releases.details:
The original 1982 album plus the 1984 mini-LP and three previously unreleased tracks. The first time on vinyl since the 80’s, in a limited-edition, red vinyl double-LP. Notes by London Cowboys’ Steve Dior and Barry Jones. From the embryonic London punk scene, they were so embedded they've played alongside both four of the Sex Pistols and four of the New York Dolls! 
Guitarist Barry Jones was a co-promoter at the famous Roxy Club (and later at Max’s KC); Steve Dior was a young punk scenester. First, The Idols formed in New York in 1978 with Steve Dior, Barry Jones and Jerry Nolan after he quit the Heartbreakers, releasing a single on US label Ork Records. The Idols (with Arthur Kane) then became Sid Vicious's band for his final Max's Kansas City shows. Jerry had UK work permit issues, so The Idols became the London Cowboys, who attracted more names from the punk scene; including Glen Matlock, Tony James and Terry Chimes. Gigging around the UK and Europe they signed with the French Underdog label in 1982, issuing Animal Pleasure in '82 and Tall in the Saddle in '84. Subsequently Barry joined Johnny Thunders band alongside Glen Matlock & Jerry Nolan (& Arthur Kane in the USA). Steve Dior formed Filthy Lucre with Phil Lewis. In 2025, Dior & Jones announced that a new London Cowboys album was being recorded in London.

releases.label: Celestial Echo
releases.details: A long-awaited official reissue of these Tom Moulton-mixed Curtis Mayfield productions. Both tracks capture the very essence of early ‘70s soul sophistication — deep grooves, lush arrangements, and powerful vocals. Celestial Echo brings them back to life, beautifully remastered from the original tapes of Tom Moulton. For Record Store Day 2026, this release highlights the golden era of soul production and Moulton’s role in defining the extended 12” format — absolutely essential for collectors and DJs alike. Remastered from the tapes.

releases.title: The Rescue
releases.label: Demon Records
releases.details:
Brand new for Record Store Day 2026, a narrated TV soundtrack of the 1965 serial starring William Hartnell as the Doctor. Comprising two episodes, The Powerful Enemy and Desperate Measures, the story features the debut of companion Vicki, played by Maureen O’Brien who now provides newly recorded linking narration and a bonus behind-the-scenes interview.

The Doctor, Ian (William Russell) and Barbara (Jacqueline Hill) discover a crashed spaceship on the planet Dido in the 25th Century. Survivors Vicki and Bennett are menaced by a terrifying native named Koquillion – or are they? The travellers risk their lives to discover the truth.

Sixty years after its original broadcast, The Rescue is presented for the first time on 140g ‘Rescue Red’ translucent vinyl in a beautifully illustrated outer sleeve depicting Koquillion, plus an illustrated inner sleeve which includes full cast and credits.

releases.title: Timeless Jazz Classics Volume 3 (Compiled by Gilles Peterson)
releases.label: Music On Vinyl
releases.details:
180 gram audiophile vinyl
Includes insert with liner notes and track-by-track information by Gilles Peterson
Collection of jazz favourites from the Dutch jazz label Timeless Records, compiled by world reknown jazz collector, labelboss, radio-jock and DJ Gilles Peterson
Featuring tracks by Carter Jefferson, Gary Bartz, Denise Jannah, Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers. Clint Houston a.o.
With previously unreleased version of "Bolivia (Live at Umbria "76)" by Eastern Rebellion 6
Limited edition of 1000 individually numbered copies on translucent yellow coloured vinyl

Gilles Peterson, renowned DJ, producer, radio host, and founder of Acid Jazz and Talkin’ Loud, returns with a new handpicked selection from the iconic Dutch Timeless Jazz label. Timeless Jazz Classics Vol. 3 is the double album featuring standout performances and rare versions by legendary artists including Gary Bartz (“Peresina”), Billy Higgins (“Sugar And Spice”), Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers (“Free For All”), Nueva Manteca and Nicky Marrero (“Afrodisia”), and Clint Houston (“Geri”). The exclusive bonus track “Bolivia (Live at Umbria ’76)” by Eastern Rebellion adds further depth to this remarkable collection.
Timeless Jazz Classics Vol. 3 is available as a limited edition of 1000 individually numbered copies on translucent yellow coloured vinyl and includes an insert with liner notes and track-by-track information by Gilles Peterson.

One of the reasons Joni is so happy with us is that we let her use her original artwork for covers. She really loved this idea. 1LP Rose coloured vinyl.

A must for Record Store Day collectors who love rare funk and the emerging disco sound that came of the era. Remastered, Redesigned labels and sleeve.

releases.title: Junto Al Mar (Deluxe Edition)

releases.details: A Balearic holy grail reborn — Miguel Tur’s Junto Al Mar captures Mediterranean sunshine through a lens of synth-pop, jazz, and gentle soul. Originally released in Venezuela in 1981, it’s become a favourite among collectors of breezy, coastal grooves but selling for over £150 for an original. For Record Store Day 2026, Deja Vu Kid presents a Deluxe Edition, Remastered with archival photos and liner notes from Micky Browne. Pure escapism and emotional warmth — the perfect soundtrack to RSD digging adventures. "Galaxy" Gold Vinyl, Remastered, Reimagined Sleeve.

releases.title: Urami Bushi/Shura No Hana
releases.label: Teichiku Entertainment / TOYOKASEI
releases.details: Meiko Kaji’s, Japanese actress and singer, most famous titles, "Urami Bushi" and "Shura no Hana,” originally released over 50 years ago, will be released for RSD 2026, being combined into a 2-in-1 set and resized to LP size instead of EP! Her debut album, "Gincho Wataridori" (1973), was hugely popular across the globe, and even reaching the French charts in 2023. Meiko Kaji is a Japanese actress and singer. She rose to fame in the 1970s with the films in the“ Female Prisoner Scorpion” series and the “Lady Snowblood” series. Her unique presence and aesthetic are highly regarded by film fans worldwide, including director Quentin Tarantino, and she has achieved a cult following across the globe.
